verses.en: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
verses.fr: Paul, serviteur de Jésus-Christ, appelé à être apôtre, mis à part pour annoncer l''Evangile de Dieu, -
verses.am: ሐዋርያ ሊሆን የተጠራ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያ ጳውሎስ በነቢያቱ አፍ በቅዱሳን

verses.en: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
verses.fr: qui avait été promis auparavant de la part de Dieu par ses prophètes dans les saintes Ecritures,
verses.am: መጻሕፍት አስቀድሞ ተስፋ ለሰጠው ለእግዚአብሔር ወንጌል ተለየ።

verses.en: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
verses.fr: et qui concerne son Fils né de la postérité de David, selon la chair,

verses.en: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
verses.fr: et déclaré Fils de Dieu avec puissance, selon l''Esprit de sainteté, par sa résurrection d''entre les morts, Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur,
verses.am: ይህም ወንጌል በሥጋ ከዳዊት ዘር ስለ ተወለደ እንደ ቅድስና መንፈስ ግን ከሙታን መነሣት የተነሣ በኃይል የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ሆኖ ስለ ተገለጠ ስለ ልጁ ነው፤ እርሱም ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው።

verses.en: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
verses.fr: par qui nous avons reçu la grâce et l''apostolat, pour amener en son nom à l''obéissance de la foi tous les païens,
verses.am: በእርሱም ስለ ስሙ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ከእምነት የሚነሣ መታዘዝ እንዲገኝ ጸጋንና ሐዋርያነትን ተቀበልን፤

verses.en: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
verses.fr: parmi lesquels vous êtes aussi, vous qui avez été appelés par Jésus-Christ, -
verses.am: በእነርሱም መካከል የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ልትሆኑ የተጠራችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ናችሁ።

verses.en: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: tous ceux qui, à Rome, sont bien-aimés de Dieu, appelés à être saints: que la grâce et la paix vous soient données de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus-Christ!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ለተወደዳችሁና ቅዱሳን ልትሆኑ ለተጠራችሁ በሮሜ ላላችሁት ሁሉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.en: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
verses.fr: Je rends d''abord grâces à mon Dieu par Jésus-Christ, au sujet de vous tous, de ce que votre foi est renommée dans le monde entier.
verses.am: እምነታችሁ በዓለም ሁሉ ስለ ተሰማች አስቀድሜ ስለ ሁላችሁ አምላኬን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
verses.fr: Dieu, que je sers en mon esprit dans l''Evangile de son Fils, m''est témoin que je fais sans cesse mention de vous,
verses.am: ትጸኑ ዘንድ መንፈሳዊ ስጦታ እንዳካፍላችሁ ላያችሁ እናፍቃለሁና፤

verses.en: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
verses.fr: demandant continuellement dans mes prières d''avoir enfin, par sa volonté, le bonheur d''aller vers vous.
verses.am: ትጸኑ ዘንድ መንፈሳዊ ስጦታ እንዳካፍላችሁ ላያችሁ እናፍቃለሁና፤

verses.en: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
verses.fr: Car je désire vous voir, pour vous communiquer quelque don spirituel, afin que vous soyez affermis,
verses.am: ይህንም ማለቴ በመካከላችን ባለች በእናንተና በእኔ እምነት አብረን በእናንተ እንድንጽናና ነው።

verses.en: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
verses.fr: ou plutôt, afin que nous soyons encouragés ensemble au milieu de vous par la foi qui nous est commune, à vous et à moi.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በሌሎቹ አሕዛብ ደግሞ እንደ ሆነ በእናንተም ፍሬ አገኝ ዘንድ ብዙ ጊዜ ወደ እናንተ ልመጣ እንዳሰብሁ እስከ አሁን ግን እንደ ተከለከልሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
verses.fr: Je ne veux pas vous laisser ignorer, frères, que j''ai souvent formé le projet d''aller vous voir, afin de recueillir quelque fruit parmi vous, comme parmi les autres nations; mais j''en ai été empêché jusqu''ici.
verses.am: ለግሪክ ሰዎችና ላልተማሩም፥ ለጥበበኞችና ለማያስተውሉም ዕዳ አለብኝ፤

verses.en: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
verses.fr: Je me dois aux Grecs et aux barbares, aux savants et aux ignorants.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በሚቻለኝ መጠን በሮሜ ላላችሁ ለእናንተ ደግሞ ወንጌልን ልሰብክ ተዘጋጅቼአለሁ።

verses.en: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
verses.fr: Ainsi j''ai un vif désir de vous annoncer aussi l''Evangile, à vous qui êtes à Rome.
verses.am: በወንጌል አላፍርምና፤ አስቀድሞ ለአይሁዳዊ ደግሞም ለግሪክ ሰው፥ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ለማዳን ነውና።

verses.en: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.fr: Car je n''ai point honte de l''Evangile: c''est une puissance de Dieu pour le salut de quiconque croit, du Juif premièrement, puis du Grec,
verses.am: ጻድቅ በእምነት ይኖራል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ከእምነት ወደ እምነት በእርሱ ይገለጣልና።

verses.en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
verses.fr: parce qu''en lui est révélée la justice de Dieu par la foi et pour la foi, selon qu''il est écrit: Le juste vivra par la foi.
verses.am: እውነትን በዓመፃ በሚከለክሉ ሰዎች በኃጢአተኝነታቸውና በዓመፃቸው ሁሉ ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ከሰማይ ይገለጣልና፤

verses.en: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
verses.fr: La colère de Dieu se révèle du ciel contre toute impiété et toute injustice des hommes qui retiennent injustement la vérité captive,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ገለጠላቸው፥ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ሊታወቅ የሚቻለው በእነርሱ ዘንድ ግልጥ ነውና።

verses.en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
verses.fr: car ce qu''on peut connaître de Dieu est manifeste pour eux, Dieu le leur ayant fait connaître.
verses.am: ጥበበኞች ነን ሲሉ ደንቆሮ ሆኑ፥

verses.en: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
verses.fr: En effet, les perfections invisibles de Dieu, sa puissance éternelle et sa divinité, se voient comme à l''oeil, depuis la création du monde, quand on les considère dans ses ouvrages. Ils sont donc inexcusables,
verses.am: ጥበበኞች ነን ሲሉ ደንቆሮ ሆኑ፥

verses.en: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
verses.fr: puisque ayant connu Dieu, ils ne l''ont point glorifié comme Dieu, et ne lui ont point rendu grâces; mais ils se sont égarés dans leurs pensées, et leur coeur sans intelligence a été plongé dans les ténèbres.
verses.am: የማይጠፋውንም የእግዚአብሔር ክብር በሚጠፋ ሰውና በወፎች አራት እግር ባላቸውም በሚንቀሳቀሱትም መልክ መስለው ለወጡ።

verses.en: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.fr: Se vantant d''être sages, ils sont devenus fous;
verses.am: ስለዚህ እርስ በርሳቸው ሥጋቸውን ሊያዋርዱ እግዚአብሔር በልባቸው ፍትወት ወደ ርኵስነት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
verses.fr: et ils ont changé la gloire du Dieu incorruptible en images représentant l''homme corruptible, des oiseaux, des quadrupèdes, et des reptiles.
verses.am: ይህም የእግዚአብሔርን እውነት በውሸት ስለ ለወጡ በፈጣሪም ፈንታ የተፈጠረውን ስላመለኩና ስላገለገሉ ነው፤ እርሱም ለዘላለም የተባረከ ነው፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi Dieu les a livrés à l''impureté, selon les convoitises de leurs coeurs; en sorte qu''ils déshonorent eux-mêmes leurs propres corps;
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ለሚያስነውር ምኞት አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ ሴቶቻቸውም ለባሕርያቸው የሚገባውን ሥራ ለባሕርያቸው በማይገባው ለወጡ፤

verses.en: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.fr: eux qui ont changé la vérité de Dieu en mensonge, et qui ont adoré et servi la créature au lieu du Créateur, qui est béni éternellement. Amen!
verses.am: እንዲሁም ወንዶች ደግሞ ለባሕርያቸው የሚገባውን ሴቶችን መገናኘት ትተው እርስ በርሳቸው በፍትወታቸው ተቃጠሉ፤ ወንዶችም በወንዶች ነውር አድርገው በስሕተታቸው የሚገባውን ብድራት በራሳቸው ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi Dieu les a livrés à des passions infâmes: car leurs femmes ont changé l''usage naturel en celui qui est contre nature;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ለማወቅ ባልወደዱት መጠን እግዚአብሔር የማይገባውን ያደርጉ ዘንድ ለማይረባ አእምሮ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
verses.fr: et de même les hommes, abandonnant l''usage naturel de la femme, se sont enflammés dans leurs désirs les uns pour les autres, commettant homme avec homme des choses infâmes, et recevant en eux-mêmes le salaire que méritait leur égarement.
verses.am: ዓመፃ ሁሉ፥ ግፍ፥ መመኘት፥ ክፋት ሞላባቸው፤ ቅናትን፥ ነፍስ መግደልን፥ ክርክርን፥ ተንኰልን፥ ክፉ ጠባይን ተሞሉ፤ የሚያሾከሹኩ፥

verses.en: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
verses.fr: Comme ils ne se sont pas souciés de connaître Dieu, Dieu les a livrés à leur sens réprouvé, pour commettre des choses indignes,
verses.am: ሐሜተኞች፥ አምላክን የሚጠሉ፥ የሚያንገላቱ፥ ትዕቢተኞች፥ ትምክህተኞች፥ ክፋትን የሚፈላለጉ፥ ለወላጆቻቸው የማይታዘዙ፥

verses.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
verses.fr: tant remplis de toute espèce d''injustice, de méchanceté, de cupidité, de malice; pleins d''envie, de meurtre, de querelle, de ruse, de malignité; rapporteurs,
verses.am: የማያስተውሉ፥ ውል የሚያፈርሱ፥ ፍቅር የሌላቸው፥ ምሕረት ያጡ ናቸው፤

verses.en: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.fr: médisants, impies, arrogants, hautains, fanfarons, ingénieux au mal, rebelles à leurs parents,
verses.am: እንደነዚህ ለሚያደርጉት ሞት ይገባቸዋል የሚለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ እያወቁ እነዚህን ከሚያደርጉ ጋር ይስማማሉ እንጂ አድራጊዎች ብቻ አይደሉም።

verses.en: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
verses.fr: dépourvus d''intelligence, de loyauté, d''affection naturelle, de miséricorde.
verses.am: የማያስተውሉ፥ ውል የሚያፈርሱ፥ ፍቅር የሌላቸው፥ ምሕረት ያጡ ናቸው፤

verses.en: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
verses.fr: Et, bien qu''ils connaissent le jugement de Dieu, déclarant dignes de mort ceux qui commettent de telles choses, non seulement ils les font, mais ils approuvent ceux qui les font.
verses.am: እንደነዚህ ለሚያደርጉት ሞት ይገባቸዋል የሚለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ እያወቁ እነዚህን ከሚያደርጉ ጋር ይስማማሉ እንጂ አድራጊዎች ብቻ አይደሉም።

verses.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
verses.fr: O homme, qui que tu sois, toi qui juges, tu es donc inexcusable; car, en jugeant les autres, tu te condamnes toi-même, puisque toi qui juges, tu fais les mêmes choses.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ አንተ የምትፈርድ ሰው ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የምታመካኘው የለህም፤ በሌላው በምትፈርድበት ነገር ራስህን ትኰንናለህና፤ አንተው ፈራጁ እነዚያን ታደርጋለህና።

verses.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
verses.fr: Nous savons, en effet, que le jugement de Dieu contre ceux qui commettent de telles choses est selon la vérité.
verses.am: እንደዚህም በሚያደርጉት ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
verses.fr: Et penses-tu, ô homme, qui juges ceux qui commettent de telles choses, et qui les fais, que tu échapperas au jugement de Dieu?
verses.am: አንተም እንደዚህ በሚያደርጉ የምትፈርድ ያንም የምታደርግ ሰው ሆይ፥ አንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ የምታመልጥ ይመስልሃልን?

verses.en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.fr: Ou méprises-tu les richesses de sa bonté, de sa patience et de sa longanimité, ne reconnaissant pas que la bonté de Dieu te pousse à la repentance?
verses.am: ወይስ የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነት ወደ ንስሐ እንዲመራህ ሳታውቅ የቸርነቱንና የመቻሉን የትዕግሥቱንም ባለጠግነት ትንቃለህን?

verses.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.fr: Mais, par ton endurcissement et par ton coeur impénitent, tu t''amasses un trésor de colère pour le jour de la colère et de la manifestation du juste jugement de Dieu,
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንደ ጥንካሬህና ንስሐ እንደማይገባ ልብህ የእግዚአብሔር ቅን ፍርድ በሚገለጥበት በቍጣ ቀን ቍጣን በራስህ ላይ ታከማቻለህ።

verses.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
verses.fr: qui rendra à chacun selon ses oeuvres;
verses.am: እርሱ ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ ሥራው ያስረክበዋል፤

verses.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
verses.fr: réservant la vie éternelle à ceux qui, par la persévérance à bien faire, cherchent l''honneur, la gloire et l''immortalité;
verses.am: በበጎ ሥራ በመጽናት ምስጋናንና ክብርን የማይጠፋንም ሕይወት ለሚፈልጉ የዘላለምን ሕይወት ይሰጣቸዋል፤

verses.en: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
verses.fr: mais l''irritation et la colère à ceux qui, par esprit de dispute, sont rebelles à la vérité et obéissent à l''injustice.
verses.am: ለዓመፃ በሚታዘዙ እንጂ ለእውነት በማይታዘዙትና በአድመኞች ላይ ግን ቍጣና መቅሠፍት ይሆንባቸዋል።

verses.en: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
verses.fr: Tribulation et angoisse sur toute âme d''homme qui fait le mal, sur le Juif premièrement, puis sur le Grec!
verses.am: ክፉውን በሚያደርግ ሰው ነፍስ ሁሉ መከራና ጭንቀት ይሆንበታል፥ አስቀድሞ በአይሁዳዊ ደግሞም በግሪክ ሰው፤

verses.en: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
verses.fr: Gloire, honneur et paix pour quiconque fait le bien, pour le Juif premièrement, puis pour le Grec!
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጎ ሥራ ለሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ምስጋናና ክብር ሰላምም ይሆንላቸዋል፥ አስቀድሞ ለአይሁዳዊ ደግሞም ለግሪክ ሰው።

verses.en: For there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.fr: Car devant Dieu il n''y a point d''acception de personnes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ፊት አያዳላምና።

verses.en: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui ont péché sans la loi périront aussi sans la loi, et tous ceux qui ont péché avec la loi seront jugés par la loi.
verses.am: ያለ ሕግ ኃጢአት ያደረጉ ሁሉ ያለ ሕግ ደግሞ ይጠፋሉና፤ ሕግም ሳላቸው ኃጢአት ያደረጉ ሁሉ በሕግ ይፈረድባቸዋል፤

verses.en: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
verses.fr: Ce ne sont pas, en effet, ceux qui écoutent la loi qui sont justes devant Dieu, mais ce sont ceux qui la mettent en pratique qui seront justifiés.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሕግን የሚያደርጉት ይጸድቃሉ እንጂ ሕግን የሚሰሙ ጻድቃን አይደሉምና።

verses.en: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
verses.fr: Quand les païens, qui n''ont point la loi, font naturellement ce que prescrit la loi, ils sont, eux qui n''ont point la loi, une loi pour eux-mêmes;
verses.am: ሕግ የሌላቸው አሕዛብ ከባሕርያቸው የሕግን ትእዛዝ ሲያደርጉ፥ እነዚያ ሕግ ባይኖራቸው እንኳ ለራሳቸው ሕግ ናቸውና፤

verses.en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
verses.fr: ils montrent que l''oeuvre de la loi est écrite dans leurs coeurs, leur conscience en rendant témoignage, et leurs pensées s''accusant ou se défendant tour à tour.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሕሊናቸው ሲመሰክርላቸው፥ አሳባቸውም እርስ በርሳቸው ሲካሰስ ወይም ሲያመካኝ በልባቸው የተጻፈውን የሕግ ሥራ ያሳያሉ።

verses.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
verses.fr: C''est ce qui paraîtra au jour où, selon mon Evangile, Dieu jugera par Jésus-Christ les actions secrètes des hommes.
verses.am: ይህም እግዚአብሔር በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እኔ በወንጌል እንዳስተማርሁ በሰው ዘንድ የተሰወረውን በሚፈርድበት ቀን ይሆናል።

verses.en: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
verses.fr: Toi qui te donnes le nom de Juif, qui te reposes sur la loi, qui te glorifies de Dieu,
verses.am: አንተ ግን አይሁዳዊ ብትባል በሕግም ብትደገፍ በእግዚአብሔርም ብትመካ፥

verses.en: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
verses.fr: qui connais sa volonté, qui apprécies la différence des choses, étant instruit par la loi;
verses.am: ፈቃዱንም ብታውቅ ከሕግም ተምረህ የሚሻለውን ፈትነህ ብትወድ፤

verses.en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
verses.fr: toi qui te flattes d''être le conducteur des aveugles, la lumière de ceux qui sont dans les ténèbres,
verses.am: እንግዲህ አንተ ሌላውን የምታስተምር ራስህን አታስተምርምን? አትስረቅ ብለህ የምትሰብክ ትሰርቃለህን?

verses.en: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
verses.fr: le docteur des insensés, le maître des ignorants, parce que tu as dans la loi la règle de la science et de la vérité;
verses.am: እንግዲህ አንተ ሌላውን የምታስተምር ራስህን አታስተምርምን? አትስረቅ ብለህ የምትሰብክ ትሰርቃለህን?

verses.en: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
verses.fr: toi donc, qui enseignes les autres, tu ne t''enseignes pas toi-même! Toi qui prêches de ne pas dérober, tu dérobes!
verses.am: አታመንዝር የምትል ታመነዝራለህን? ጣዖትን የምትጸየፍ ቤተ መቅደስን ትዘርፋለህን?

verses.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
verses.fr: Toi qui dis de ne pas commettre d''adultère, tu commets l''adultère! Toi qui as en abomination les idoles, tu commets des sacrilèges!
verses.am: በሕግ የምትመካ ሕግን በመተላለፍ እግዚአብሔርን ታሳፍራለህን?

verses.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
verses.fr: Toi qui te fais une gloire de la loi, tu déshonores Dieu par la transgression de la loi!
verses.am: በእናንተ ሰበብ የእግዚአብሔር ስም በአሕዛብ መካከል ይሰደባልና ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።

verses.en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
verses.fr: Car le nom de Dieu est à cause de vous blasphémé parmi les païens, comme cela est écrit.
verses.am: ሕግን ብታደርግ መገረዝስ ይጠቅማል፤ ሕግን ተላላፊ ብትሆን ግን መገረዝህ አለ መገረዝ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
verses.fr: La circoncision est utile, si tu mets en pratique la loi; mais si tu transgresses la loi, ta circoncision devient incirconcision.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ያልተገረዘ ሰው የሕግን ሥርዓት ቢጠብቅ አለመገረዙ እንደ መገረዝ ሆኖ አይቈጠርለትምን?

verses.en: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
verses.fr: Si donc l''incirconcis observe les ordonnances de la loi, son incirconcision ne sera-t-elle pas tenue pour circoncision?
verses.am: ከፍጥረቱም ያልተገረዘ ሕግን የሚፈጽም ሰው የሕግ መጽሐፍና መገረዝ ሳለህ ሕግን በምትተላለፈው በአንተ ይፈርድብሃል።

verses.en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
verses.fr: L''incirconcis de nature, qui accomplit la loi, ne te condamnera-t-il pas, toi qui la transgresses, tout en ayant la lettre de la loi et la circoncision?
verses.am: በግልጥ አይሁዳዊ የሆነ አይሁዳዊ አይደለምና፥ በግልጥ በሥጋ የሚደረግ መገረዝም መገረዝ አይደለምና፤

verses.en: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
verses.fr: Le Juif, ce n''est pas celui qui en a les dehors; et la circoncision, ce n''est pas celle qui est visible dans la chair.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን በስውር አይሁዳዊ የሆነ አይሁዳዊ ነው፥ መገረዝም በመንፈስ የሚደረግ የልብ መገረዝ ነው እንጂ በመጽሐፍ አይደለም፤ የእርሱ ምስጋና ከእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ ከሰው አይደለም።

verses.en: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
verses.fr: Mais le Juif, c''est celui qui l''est intérieurement; et la circoncision, c''est celle du coeur, selon l''esprit et non selon la lettre. La louange de ce Juif ne vient pas des hommes, mais de Dieu.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን በስውር አይሁዳዊ የሆነ አይሁዳዊ ነው፥ መገረዝም በመንፈስ የሚደረግ የልብ መገረዝ ነው እንጂ በመጽሐፍ አይደለም፤ የእርሱ ምስጋና ከእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ ከሰው አይደለም።

verses.en: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
verses.fr: Quel est donc l''avantage des Juifs, ou quelle est l''utilité de la circoncision?
verses.am: እንግዲህ የአይሁዳዊ ብልጫው ምንድር ነው? ወይስ የመገረዝ ጥቅሙ ምንድር ነው? በሁሉ ነገር ብዙ ነው።

verses.en: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.fr: Il est grand de toute manière, et tout d''abord en ce que les oracles de Dieu leur ont été confiés.
verses.am: አስቀድሞ የእግዚአብሔር ቃላት አደራ ተሰጡአቸው። ታዲያ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
verses.fr: Eh quoi! si quelques-uns n''ont pas cru, leur incrédulité anéantira-t-elle la fidélité de Dieu?
verses.am: የማያምኑ ቢኖሩ አለማመናቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ታማኝነት ያስቀራልን?

verses.en: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
verses.fr: Loin de là! Que Dieu, au contraire, soit reconnu pour vrai, et tout homme pour menteur, selon qu''il est écrit: Afin que tu sois trouvé juste dans tes paroles, Et que tu triomphes lorsqu''on te juge.
verses.am: እንዲህ አይሁን፤ በቃልህ ትጸድቅ ዘንድ ወደ ፍርድ በገባህም ጊዜ ትረታ ዘንድ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ ሰው ሁሉ ውሸተኛ ከሆነ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ ይሁን።

verses.en: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.fr: Mais si notre injustice établit la justice de Dieu, que dirons-nous? Dieu est-il injuste quand il déchaîne sa colère? Je parle à la manière des hommes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዓመፃችን የእግዚአብሔርን ጽድቅ የሚያስረዳ ከሆነ ምን እንላለን? ቍጣን የሚያመጣ እግዚአብሔር ዓመፀኛ ነውን? እንደ ሰው ልማድ እላለሁ።

verses.en: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.fr: Loin de là! Autrement, comment Dieu jugerait-il le monde?
verses.am: እንዲህ አይሁን፤ እንዲህ ቢሆን እግዚአብሔር በዓለም እንዴት ይፈርዳል?

verses.en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.fr: Et si, par mon mensonge, la vérité de Dieu éclate davantage pour sa gloire, pourquoi suis-je moi-même encore jugé comme pécheur?
verses.am: በእኔ ውሸት ግን የእግዚአብሔር እውነት ለክብሩ ከላቀ ስለምን በእኔ ደግሞ እንደ ኃጢአተኛ ገና ይፈርድብኛል?

verses.en: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.fr: Et pourquoi ne ferions-nous pas le mal afin qu''il en arrive du bien, comme quelques-uns, qui nous calomnient, prétendent que nous le disons? La condamnation de ces gens est juste.
verses.am: ስለ ምንስ መልካም እንዲመጣ ክፉ አናደርግም? እንዲሁ ይሰድቡናልና አንዳንዱም እንዲሁ እንድንል ይናገራሉና። የእነርሱም ፍርድ ቅን ነው።

verses.en: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.fr: Quoi donc! sommes-nous plus excellents? Nullement. Car nous avons déjà prouvé que tous, Juifs et Grecs, sont sous l''empire du péché,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን ይሁን? ከእነርሱ እንበልጣለንን? ከቶ አይደለም፤ አይሁድም የግሪክ ሰዎችም ሁሉ ከኃጢአት በታች እንደ ሆኑ አስቀድመን ከሰናቸዋልና፤

verses.en: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: Il n''y a point de juste, Pas même un seul;
verses.am: እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።

verses.en: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.fr: Nul n''est intelligent, Nul ne cherche Dieu;
verses.am: ጻድቅ የለም አንድ ስንኳ፤ አስተዋይም የለም፤ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ የለም፤ ሁሉ ተሳስተዋል፥

verses.en: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.fr: Tous sont égarés, tous sont pervertis; Il n''en est aucun qui fasse le bien, Pas même un seul;
verses.am: በአንድነትም የማይጠቅሙ ሆነዋል፤ ቸርነት የሚያደርግ የለም፥ አንድ ስንኳ የለም።

verses.en: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
verses.fr: Leur gosier est un sépulcre ouvert; Ils se servent de leurs langues pour tromper; Ils ont sous leurs lèvres un venin d''aspic;
verses.am: ጕሮሮአቸው እንደ ተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ በመላሳቸውም ሸንግለዋል፤ የእባብ መርዝ ከከንፈሮቻቸው በታች አለ፤

verses.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.fr: Leur bouche est pleine de malédiction et d''amertume;
verses.am: አፋቸውም እርግማንና መራርነት ሞልቶበታል፤

verses.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
verses.fr: Ils ont les pieds légers pour répandre le sang;
verses.am: እግሮቻቸው ደምን ለማፍሰስ ፈጣኖች ናቸው፤

verses.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
verses.fr: La destruction et le malheur sont sur leur route;
verses.am: ጥፋትና ጉስቁልና በመንገዳቸው ይገኛል፥

verses.en: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.fr: Ils ne connaissent pas le chemin de la paix;
verses.am: አፍም ሁሉ ይዘጋ ዘንድ ዓለምም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ በታች ይሆን ዘንድ ሕግ የሚናገረው ሁሉ ከሕግ በታች ላሉት እንዲናገር እናውቃለን፤

verses.en: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.fr: La crainte de Dieu n''est pas devant leurs yeux.
verses.am: አፍም ሁሉ ይዘጋ ዘንድ ዓለምም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ በታች ይሆን ዘንድ ሕግ የሚናገረው ሁሉ ከሕግ በታች ላሉት እንዲናገር እናውቃለን፤

verses.en: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.fr: Or, nous savons que tout ce que dit la loi, elle le dit à ceux qui sont sous la loi, afin que toute bouche soit fermée, et que tout le monde soit reconnu coupable devant Dieu.
verses.am: ይህም የሕግን ሥራ በመሥራት ሥጋ የለበሰ ሁሉ በእርሱ ፊት ስለማይጸድቅ ነው፤ ኃጢአት በሕግ ይታወቃልና።

verses.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
verses.fr: Car nul ne sera justifié devant lui par les oeuvres de la loi, puisque c''est par la loi que vient la connaissance du péché.
verses.am: አሁን ግን በሕግና በነቢያት የተመሰከረለት የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ያለ ሕግ ተገልጦአል፥

verses.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.fr: Mais maintenant, sans la loi est manifestée la justice de Dieu, à laquelle rendent témoignage la loi et les prophètes,
verses.am: እርሱም፥ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ የሆነ፥ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በማመን የሚገኘው የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ ነው፤ ልዩነት የለምና፤

verses.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.fr: justice de Dieu par la foi en Jésus-Christ pour tous ceux qui croient. Il n''y a point de distinction.
verses.am: ሁሉ ኃጢአትን ሠርተዋልና የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ጎድሎአቸዋል፤

verses.en: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.fr: Car tous ont péché et sont privés de la gloire de Dieu;
verses.am: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም በሆነው ቤዛነት በኩል እንዲያው በጸጋው ይጸድቃሉ።

verses.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.fr: et ils sont gratuitement justifiés par sa grâce, par le moyen de la rédemption qui est en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እርሱንም እግዚአብሔር በእምነት የሚገኝ በደሙም የሆነ ማስተስሪያ አድርጎ አቆመው፤ ይህም በፊት የተደረገውን ኃጢአት በእግዚአብሔር ችሎታ ስለ መተው ጽድቁን ያሳይ ዘንድ ነው፥

verses.en: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verses.fr: C''est lui que Dieu a destiné, par son sang, à être, pour ceux qui croiraient victime propitiatoire, afin de montrer sa justice, parce qu''il avait laissé impunis les péchés commis auparavant, au temps de sa patience, afin, dis-je,
verses.am: ራሱም ጻድቅ እንዲሆን በኢየሱስም የሚያምነውን እንዲያጸድቅ አሁን በዚህ ዘመን ጽድቁን ያሳይ ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.fr: de montrer sa justice dans le temps présent, de manière à être juste tout en justifiant celui qui a la foi en Jésus.
verses.am: ትምክህት እንግዲህ ወዴት ነው? እርሱ ቀርቶአል። በየትኛው ሕግ ነው? በሥራ ሕግ ነውን? አይደለም፥ በእምነት ሕግ ነው እንጂ።

verses.en: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.fr: Où donc est le sujet de se glorifier? Il est exclu. Par quelle loi? Par la loi des oeuvres? Non, mais par la loi de la foi.
verses.am: ሰው ያለ ሕግ ሥራ በእምነት እንዲጸድቅ እንቆጥራለንና።

verses.en: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.fr: Car nous pensons que l''homme est justifié par la foi, sans les oeuvres de la loi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሕግን በእምነት እንሽራለንን? አይደለም፤ ሕግን እናጸናለን እንጂ።

verses.en: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.fr: Ou bien Dieu est-il seulement le Dieu des Juifs? Ne l''est-il pas aussi des païens? Oui, il l''est aussi des païens,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሕግን በእምነት እንሽራለንን? አይደለም፤ ሕግን እናጸናለን እንጂ።

verses.en: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
verses.fr: puisqu''il y a un seul Dieu, qui justifiera par la foi les circoncis, et par la foi les incirconcis.
verses.am: ወይስ እግዚአብሔር የአይሁድ ብቻ አምላክ ነውን? የአሕዛብስ ደግሞ አምላክ አይደለምን? አዎን፥ የተገረዘን ስለ እምነት ያልተገረዘንም በእምነት የሚያጸድቅ አምላክ አንድ ስለ ሆነ የአሕዛብ ደግሞ አምላክ ነው።

verses.en: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
verses.fr: Anéantissons-nous donc la loi par la foi? Loin de là! Au contraire, nous confirmons la loi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሕግን በእምነት እንሽራለንን? አይደለም፤ ሕግን እናጸናለን እንጂ።

verses.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.fr: Que dirons-nous donc qu''Abraham, notre père, a obtenu selon la chair?
verses.am: እንግዲህ በሥጋ አባታችን የሆነ አብርሃም ምን አገኘ እንላለን?

verses.en: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
verses.fr: Si Abraham a été justifié par les oeuvres, il a sujet de se glorifier, mais non devant Dieu.
verses.am: አብርሃም በሥራ ጸድቆ ቢሆን የሚመካበት አለውና፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አይደለም።

verses.en: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.fr: Car que dit l''Ecriture? Abraham crut à Dieu, et cela lui fut imputé à justice.
verses.am: መጽሐፍስ ምን አለ? አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ ጽድቅም ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት።

verses.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.fr: Or, à celui qui fait une oeuvre, le salaire est imputé, non comme une grâce, mais comme une chose due;
verses.am: ለሚሠራ ደመወዝ እንደ ዕዳ ነው እንጂ እንደ ጸጋ አይቈጠርለትም፤

verses.en: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.fr: et à celui qui ne fait point d''oeuvre, mais qui croit en celui qui justifie l''impie, sa foi lui est imputée à justice.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለማይሠራ፥ ኃጢአተኛውንም በሚያደድቅ ለሚያምን ሰው እምነቱ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ይቆጠርለታል።

verses.en: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.fr: De même David exprime le bonheur de l''homme à qui Dieu impute la justice sans les oeuvres:
verses.am: እንደዚህ ዳዊት ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ያለ ሥራ ጽድቅን ስለሚቆጥርለት ስለ ሰው ብፅዕና ይናገራል እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.en: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux dont les iniquités sont pardonnées, Et dont les péchés sont couverts!
verses.am: ዓመፃቸው የተሰረየላቸው ኃጢአታቸውም የተከደነላቸው ብፁዓን ናቸው፤

verses.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.fr: Heureux l''homme à qui le Seigneur n''impute pas son péché!
verses.am: ጌታ ኃጢአቱን የማይቆጥርበት ሰው ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.fr: Ce bonheur n''est-il que pour les circoncis, ou est-il également pour les incirconcis? Car nous disons que la foi fut imputée à justice à Abraham.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ይህ ብፅዕና ስለ መገረዝ ተነገረ? ወይስ ደግሞ ስለ አለመገረዝ? እምነቱ ለአብርሃም ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት እንላለንና።

verses.en: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.fr: Comment donc lui fut-elle imputée? Etait-ce après, ou avant sa circoncision? Il n''était pas encore circoncis, il était incirconcis.
verses.am: እንዴት ተቆጠረለት? ተገርዞ ሳለ ነውን? ወይስ ሳይገረዝ? ተገርዞስ አይደለም፥ ሳይገረዝ ነበር እንጂ።

verses.en: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.fr: Et il reçut le signe de la circoncision, comme sceau de la justice qu''il avait obtenue par la foi quand il était incirconcis, afin d''être le père de tous les incirconcis qui croient, pour que la justice leur fût aussi imputée,
verses.am: ሳይገረዝም በነበረው እምነት ያገኘው የጽድቅ ማኅተም የሆነ የመገረዝን ምልክት ተቀበለ፤ ይህም እነርሱ ደግሞ ጻድቃን ሆነው ይቆጠሩ ዘንድ ሳይገረዙ ለሚያምኑ ሁሉ አባት እንዲሆን ነው፥

verses.en: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
verses.fr: et le père des circoncis, qui ne sont pas seulement circoncis, mais encore qui marchent sur les traces de la foi de notre père Abraham quand il était incirconcis.
verses.am: ለተገረዙትም አባት እንዲሆን ነው፤ ይኸውም ለተገረዙት ብቻ አይደለም ነገር ግን አባታችን አብርሃም ሳይገረዝ የነበረውን የእምነቱን ፍለጋ ደግሞ ለሚከተሉ ነው።

verses.en: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.fr: En effet, ce n''est pas par la loi que l''héritage du monde a été promis à Abraham ou à sa postérité, c''est par la justice de la foi.
verses.am: የዓለምም ወራሽ እንዲሆን ለአብርሃምና ለዘሩ የተሰጠው የተስፋ ቃል በእምነት ጽድቅ ነው እንጂ በሕግ አይደለም።

verses.en: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.fr: Car, si les héritiers le sont par la loi, la foi est vaine, et la promesse est anéantie,
verses.am: ከሕግ የሆኑትስ ወራሾች ከሆኑ እምነት ከንቱ ሆኖአል የተስፋውም ቃል ተሽሮአል፤

verses.en: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
verses.fr: parce que la loi produit la colère, et que là où il n''y a point de loi il n''y a point non plus de transgression.
verses.am: ሕጉ መቅሠፍትን ያደርጋልና፤ ነገር ግን ሕግ በሌለበት መተላለፍ የለም።

verses.en: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi les héritiers le sont par la foi, pour que ce soit par grâce, afin que la promesse soit assurée à toute la postérité, non seulement à celle qui est sous la loi, mais aussi à celle qui a la foi d''Abraham, notre père à tous,
verses.am: ዘርህ እንዲሁ ሊሆን ነው እንደ ተባለ፥ ተስፋ ባልሆነው ጊዜ የብዙ አሕዛብ አባት እንዲሆን ተስፋ ይዞ አመነ።

verses.en: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: Je t''ai établi père d''un grand nombre de nations. Il est notre père devant celui auquel il a cru, Dieu, qui donne la vie aux morts, et qui appelle les choses qui ne sont point comme si elles étaient.
verses.am: ዘርህ እንዲሁ ሊሆን ነው እንደ ተባለ፥ ተስፋ ባልሆነው ጊዜ የብዙ አሕዛብ አባት እንዲሆን ተስፋ ይዞ አመነ።

verses.en: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.fr: Espérant contre toute espérance, il crut, en sorte qu''il devint père d''un grand nombre de nations, selon ce qui lui avait été dit: Telle sera ta postérité.
verses.am: የመቶ ዓመትም ሽማግሌ ስለ ሆነ እንደ ምውት የሆነውን የራሱን ሥጋና የሳራ ማኅፀን ምውት መሆኑን በእምነቱ ሳይደክም ተመለከተ፤

verses.en: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb:
verses.fr: Et, sans faiblir dans la foi, il ne considéra point que son corps était déjà usé, puisqu''il avait près de cent ans, et que Sara n''était plus en état d''avoir des enfants.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት።

verses.en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.fr: Il ne douta point, par incrédulité, au sujet de la promesse de Dieu; mais il fut fortifié par la foi, donnant gloire à Dieu,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት።

verses.en: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.fr: et ayant la pleine conviction que ce qu''il promet il peut aussi l''accomplir.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ተቈጠረለት የሚለው ቃል ስለ እርሱ ብቻ የተጻፈ አይደለም፥ ስለ እኛም ነው እንጂ፤

verses.en: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi cela lui fut imputé à justice.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት።

verses.en: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.fr: Mais ce n''est pas à cause de lui seul qu''il est écrit que cela lui fut imputé;
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ተቈጠረለት የሚለው ቃል ስለ እርሱ ብቻ የተጻፈ አይደለም፥ ስለ እኛም ነው እንጂ፤

verses.en: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.fr: c''est encore à cause de nous, à qui cela sera imputé, à nous qui croyons en celui qui a ressuscité des morts Jésus notre Seigneur,

verses.en: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.fr: lequel a été livré pour nos offenses, et est ressuscité pour notre justification.
verses.am: ስለ በደላችን አልፎ የተሰጠውን እኛን ስለ ማጽደቅም የተነሣውን ጌታንችንን ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ባስነሣው ለምናምን ለእኛ ይቈጠርልን ዘንድ አለው።

verses.en: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.fr: Etant donc justifiés par la foi, nous avons la paix avec Dieu par notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: እንግዲህ በእምነት ከጸደቅን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሰላምን እንያዝ፤

verses.en: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.fr: qui nous devons d''avoir eu par la foi accès à cette grâce, dans laquelle nous demeurons fermes, et nous nous glorifions dans l''espérance de la gloire de Dieu.
verses.am: በእርሱም ደግሞ ወደ ቆምንበት ወደዚህ ጸጋ በእምነት መግባትን አግኝተናል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ክብርም ተስፋ እንመካለን።

verses.en: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.fr: Bien plus, nous nous glorifions même des afflictions, sachant que l''affliction produit la persévérance,

verses.en: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.fr: la persévérance la victoire dans l''épreuve, et cette victoire l''espérance.
verses.am: ይህም ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን መከራ ትዕግሥትን እንዲያደርግ፥ ትዕግሥትም ፈተናን ፈተናም ተስፋን እንዲያደርግ እያወቅን፥ በመከራችን ደግሞ እንመካለን፤

verses.en: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.fr: Or, l''espérance ne trompe point, parce que l''amour de Dieu est répandu dans nos coeurs par le Saint-Esprit qui nous a été donné.
verses.am: በተሰጠንም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር በልባችን ስለ ፈሰሰ ተስፋ አያሳፍርም።

verses.en: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.fr: Car, lorsque nous étions encore sans force, Christ, au temps marqué, est mort pour des impies.
verses.am: ገና ደካሞች ሳለን ክርስቶስ ዘመኑ ሲደርስ ስለ ኃጢአተኞች ሞቶአልና።

verses.en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.fr: A peine mourrait-on pour un juste; quelqu''un peut-être mourrait-il pour un homme de bien.
verses.am: ስለ ጻድቅ የሚሞት በጭንቅ ይገኛልና፤ ስለ ቸር ሰው ግን ሊሞት እንኳ የሚደፍር ምናልባት ይገኝ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu prouve son amour envers nous, en ce que, lorsque nous étions encore des pécheurs, Christ est mort pour nous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ገና ኃጢአተኞች ሳለን ክርስቶስ ስለ እኛ ሞቶአልና እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ ያለውን የራሱን ፍቅር ያስረዳል።

verses.en: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.fr: A plus forte raison donc, maintenant que nous sommes justifiés par son sang, serons-nous sauvés par lui de la colère.
verses.am: ይልቁንስ እንግዲህ አሁን በደሙ ከጸደቅን በእርሱ ከቍጣው እንድናለን።

verses.en: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.fr: Car si, lorsque nous étions ennemis, nous avons été réconciliés avec Dieu par la mort de son Fils, à plus forte raison, étant réconciliés, serons-nous sauvés par sa vie.
verses.am: ጠላቶች ሳለን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር በልጁ ሞት ከታረቅን፥ ይልቁንም ከታረቅን በኋላ በሕይወቱ እንድናለን፤

verses.en: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.fr: Et non seulement cela, mais encore nous nous glorifions en Dieu par notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, par qui maintenant nous avons obtenu la réconciliation.
verses.am: ይህም ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን አሁን መታረቁን ባገኘንበት በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል በእግዚአብሔር ደግሞ እንመካለን።

verses.en: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, comme par un seul homme le péché est entré dans le monde, et par le péché la mort, et qu''ainsi la mort s''est étendue sur tous les hommes, parce que tous ont péché,...
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምክንያት ኃጢአት በአንድ ሰው ወደ ዓለም ገባ በኃጢአትም ሞት፥ እንደዚሁም ሁሉ ኃጢአትን ስላደረጉ ሞት ለሰው ሁሉ ደረሰ፤

verses.en: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.fr: car jusqu''à la loi le péché était dans le monde. Or, le péché n''est pas imputé, quand il n''y a point de loi.
verses.am: ሕግ እስከ መጣ ድረስ ኃጢአት በዓለም ነበረና ነገር ግን ሕግ በሌለበት ጊዜ ኃጢአት አይቈጠርም፤

verses.en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.fr: Cependant la mort a régné depuis Adam jusqu''à Moïse, même sur ceux qui n''avaient pas péché par une transgression semblable à celle d''Adam, lequel est la figure de celui qui devait venir.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በአዳም መተላለፍ ምሳሌ ኃጢአትን ባልሠሩት ላይ እንኳ፥ ከአዳም ጀምሮ እስከ ሙሴ ድረስ ሞት ነገሠ፤ አዳም ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው ለእርሱ አምሳሉ ነውና።

verses.en: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
verses.fr: Mais il n''en est pas du don gratuit comme de l''offense; car, si par l''offense d''un seul il en est beaucoup qui sont morts, à plus forte raison la grâce de Dieu et le don de la grâce venant d''un seul homme, Jésus-Christ, ont-ils été abondamment répandus sur beaucoup.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስጦታው እንደ በደሉ መጠን እንደዚያው አይደለም፤ በአንድ ሰው በደል ብዙዎቹ ሞተዋልና፥ ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋና በአንድ ሰው በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ የሆነው ስጦታ ከዚያ ይልቅ ለብዙዎች በዛ።

verses.en: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
verses.fr: Et il n''en est pas du don comme de ce qui est arrivé par un seul qui a péché; car c''est après une seule offense que le jugement est devenu condamnation, tandis que le don gratuit devient justification après plusieurs offenses.
verses.am: አንድ ሰውም ኃጢአትን በማድረጉ እንደ ሆነው መጠን እንደዚያው ስጦታው አይደለም፤ ፍርድ ከአንድ ሰው ለኵነኔ መጥቶአልና፥ ስጦታው ግን በብዙ በደል ለማጽደቅ መጣ።

verses.en: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
verses.fr: Si par l''offense d''un seul la mort a régné par lui seul, à plus forte raison ceux qui reçoivent l''abondance de la grâce et du don de la justice régneront-ils dans la vie par Jésus-Christ lui seul.
verses.am: በአንዱም በደል ሞት በአንዱ በኩል ከነገሠ፥ ይልቁን የጸጋን ብዛትና የጽድቅን ስጦታ ብዛት የሚቀበሉ በአንዱ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል በሕይወት ይነግሣሉ።

verses.en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, comme par une seule offense la condamnation a atteint tous les hommes, de même par un seul acte de justice la justification qui donne la vie s''étend à tous les hommes.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በአንድ በደል ምክንያት ፍርድ ለኵነኔ ወደ ሰው ሁሉ እንደ መጣ፥ እንዲሁም በአንድ ጽድቅ ምክንያት ስጦታው ሕይወትን ለማጽደቅ ወደ ሰው ሁሉ መጣ።

verses.en: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.fr: Car, comme par la désobéissance d''un seul homme beaucoup ont été rendus pécheurs, de même par l''obéissance d''un seul beaucoup seront rendus justes.
verses.am: በአንዱ ሰው አለመታዘዝ ብዙዎች ኃጢአተኞች እንደ ሆኑ፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ በአንዱ መታዘዝ ብዙዎች ጻድቃን ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.fr: Or, la loi est intervenue pour que l''offense abondât, mais là où le péché a abondé, la grâce a surabondé,

verses.en: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.fr: afin que, comme le péché a régné par la mort, ainsi la grâce régnât par la justice pour la vie éternelle, par Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur.
verses.am: በደልም እንዲበዛ ሕግ ጭምር ገባ፤ ዳሩ ግን ኃጢአት በበዛበት፥ ኃጢአት በሞት እንደ ነገሠ፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ ጸጋ ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የተነሣ በጽድቅ ምክንያት ለዘላለም ሕይወት ይነግሥ ዘንድ፥ ጸጋ ከመጠን ይልቅ በለጠ።

verses.en: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.fr: Que dirons-nous donc? Demeurerions-nous dans le péché, afin que la grâce abonde?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? ጸጋ እንዲበዛ በኃጢአት ጸንተን እንኑርን? አይደለም።

verses.en: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.fr: Loin de là! Nous qui sommes morts au péché, comment vivrions-nous encore dans le péché?
verses.am: ለኃጢአት የሞትን እኛ ወደ ፊት እንዴት አድርገን በእርሱ እንኖራለን?

verses.en: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
verses.fr: Ignorez-vous que nous tous qui avons été baptisés en Jésus-Christ, c''est en sa mort que nous avons été baptisés?
verses.am: ወይስ ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ጋር አንድ እንሆን ዘንድ የተጠመቅን ሁላችን ከሞቱ ጋር አንድ እንሆን ዘንድ እንደ ተጠመቅን አታውቁምን?

verses.en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.fr: Nous avons donc été ensevelis avec lui par le baptême en sa mort, afin que, comme Christ est ressuscité des morts par la gloire du Père, de même nous aussi nous marchions en nouveauté de vie.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ክርስቶስ በአብ ክብር ከሙታን እንደ ተነሣ እንዲሁ እኛም በአዲስ ሕይወት እንድንመላለስ፥ ከሞቱ ጋር አንድ እንሆን ዘንድ በጥምቀት ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀበርን።

verses.en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
verses.fr: En effet, si nous sommes devenus une même plante avec lui par la conformité à sa mort, nous le serons aussi par la conformité à sa résurrection,
verses.am: ሞቱንም በሚመስል ሞት ከእርሱ ጋር ከተባበርን ትንሣኤውን በሚመስል ትንሣኤ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር እንተባበራለን፤

verses.en: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.fr: sachant que notre vieil homme a été crucifié avec lui, afin que le corps du péché fût détruit, pour que nous ne soyons plus esclaves du péché;
verses.am: ከእንግዲህስ ወዲያ ለኃጢአት እንዳንገዛ የኃጢአት ሥጋ ይሻር ዘንድ አሮጌው ሰዋችን ከእርሱ ጋር እንደ ተሰቀለ እናውቃለን፤ የሞተስ ከኃጢአቱ ጸድቋልና።

verses.en: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
verses.fr: car celui qui est mort est libre du péché.

verses.en: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.fr: Or, si nous sommes morts avec Christ, nous croyons que nous vivrons aussi avec lui,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከክርስቶስ ጋር ከሞትን ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ በሕይወት እንድንኖር እናምናለን፤

verses.en: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
verses.fr: sachant que Christ ressuscité des morts ne meurt plus; la mort n''a plus de pouvoir sur lui.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ከሙታን ተነሥቶ ወደ ፊት እንዳይሞት ሞትም ወደ ፊት እንዳይገዛው እናውቃለንና።

verses.en: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.fr: Car il est mort, et c''est pour le péché qu''il est mort une fois pour toutes; il est revenu à la vie, et c''est pour Dieu qu''il vit.
verses.am: መሞትን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ለኃጢአት ሞቶአልና፤ በሕይወት መኖርን ግን ለእግዚአብሔር ይኖራል።

verses.en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi vous-mêmes, regardez-vous comme morts au péché, et comme vivants pour Dieu en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እንዲሁም እናንተ ደግሞ ለኃጢአት እንደ ሞታችሁ፥ ግን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በጌታችን ሆናችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ሕያዋን እንደ ሆናችሁ ራሳችሁን ቈጠሩ።

verses.en: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.fr: Que le péché ne règne donc point dans votre corps mortel, et n''obéissez pas à ses convoitises.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ለምኞቱ እንድትታዘዙ በሚሞት ሥጋችሁ ኃጢአት አይንገሥ፤

verses.en: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
verses.fr: Ne livrez pas vos membres au péché, comme des instruments d''iniquité; mais donnez-vous vous-mêmes à Dieu, comme étant vivants de morts que vous étiez, et offrez à Dieu vos membres, comme des instruments de justice.
verses.am: ብልቶቻችሁንም የዓመፃ የጦር ዕቃ አድርጋችሁ ለኃጢአት አታቅርቡ፥ ነገር ግን ከሙታን ተለይታችሁ በሕይወት እንደምትኖሩ ራሳችሁን ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርቡ፥ ብልቶቻችሁንም የጽድቅ የጦር ዕቃ አድርጋችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርቡ።

verses.en: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.fr: Car le péché n''aura point de pouvoir sur vous, puisque vous êtes, non sous la loi, mais sous la grâce.
verses.am: ኃጢአት አይገዛችሁምና፤ ከጸጋ በታች እንጂ ከሕግ በታች አይደላችሁምና።

verses.en: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.fr: Quoi donc! Pécherions-nous, parce que nous sommes, non sous la loi, mais sous la grâce? Loin de là!
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን ይሁን? ከጸጋ በታች እንጂ ከሕግ በታች ስላይደለን ኃጢአትን እንሥራን? አይደለም።

verses.en: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.fr: Ne savez-vous pas qu''en vous livrant à quelqu''un comme esclaves pour lui obéir, vous êtes esclaves de celui à qui vous obéissez, soit du péché qui conduit à la mort, soit de l''obéissance qui conduit à la justice?
verses.am: ለመታዘዝ ባሪያዎች እንድትሆኑ ራሳችሁን ለምታቀርቡለት፥ ለእርሱ ለምትታዘዙለት ባሪያዎች እንደ ሆናችሁ አታውቁምን? ወይም ለሞት የኃጢአት ባሪያዎች ወይም ለጽድቅ የመታዘዝ ባሪያዎች ናችሁ።

verses.en: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
verses.fr: Mais grâces soient rendues à Dieu de ce que, après avoir été esclaves du péché, vous avez obéi de coeur à la règle de doctrine dans laquelle vous avez été instruits.
verses.am: ስለ ሥጋችሁ ድካም እንደ ሰው ልማድ እላለሁ። ብልቶቻችሁ ዓመፃ ሊያደርጉ ለርኵስነትና ለዓመፃ ባሪያዎች አድርጋችሁ እንዳቀረባችሁ፥ እንደዚሁ ብልቶቻችሁ ሊቀደሱ ለጽድቅ ባሪያዎች አድርጋችሁ አሁን አቅርቡ።

verses.en: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
verses.fr: Ayant été affranchis du péché, vous êtes devenus esclaves de la justice. -
verses.am: ስለ ሥጋችሁ ድካም እንደ ሰው ልማድ እላለሁ። ብልቶቻችሁ ዓመፃ ሊያደርጉ ለርኵስነትና ለዓመፃ ባሪያዎች አድርጋችሁ እንዳቀረባችሁ፥ እንደዚሁ ብልቶቻችሁ ሊቀደሱ ለጽድቅ ባሪያዎች አድርጋችሁ አሁን አቅርቡ።

verses.en: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.fr: Je parle à la manière des hommes, à cause de la faiblesse de votre chair. -De même donc que vous avez livré vos membres comme esclaves à l''impureté et à l''iniquité, pour arriver à l''iniquité, ainsi maintenant livrez vos membres comme esclaves à la justice, pour arriver à la sainteté.
verses.am: የኃጢአት ባሪያዎች ሳላችሁ ከጽድቅ ነፃ ነበራችሁና።

verses.en: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
verses.fr: Car, lorsque vous étiez esclaves du péché, vous étiez libres à l''égard de la justice.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ዛሬ ከምታፍሩበት ነገር ያን ጊዜ ምን ፍሬ ነበራችሁ? የዚህ ነገር መጨረሻው ሞት ነውና።

verses.en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
verses.fr: Quels fruits portiez-vous alors? Des fruits dont vous rougissez aujourd''hui. Car la fin de ces choses, c''est la mort.
verses.am: አሁን ግን ከኃጢአት አርነት ወጥታችሁ ለእግዚአብሔርም ተገዝታችሁ፥ ልትቀደሱ ፍሬ አላችሁ፤ መጨረሻውም የዘላለም ሕይወት ነው።

verses.en: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant, étant affranchis du péché et devenus esclaves de Dieu, vous avez pour fruit la sainteté et pour fin la vie éternelle.
verses.am: የኃጢአት ደመወዝ ሞት ነውና፤ የእግዚአብሔር የጸጋ ስጦታ ግን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በጌታችን የዘላለም ሕይወት ነው።

verses.en: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.fr: Car le salaire du péché, c''est la mort; mais le don gratuit de Dieu, c''est la vie éternelle en Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur.
verses.am: የኃጢአት ደመወዝ ሞት ነውና፤ የእግዚአብሔር የጸጋ ስጦታ ግን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በጌታችን የዘላለም ሕይወት ነው።

verses.en: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
verses.fr: Ignorez-vous, frères, -car je parle à des gens qui connaissent la loi, -que la loi exerce son pouvoir sur l''homme aussi longtemps qu''il vit?
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሕግን ለሚያውቁ እናገራለሁና ሰው ባለበት ዘመን ሁሉ ሕግ እንዲገዛው አታውቁምን?

verses.en: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
verses.fr: Ainsi, une femme mariée est liée par la loi à son mari tant qu''il est vivant; mais si le mari meurt, elle est dégagée de la loi qui la liait à son mari.
verses.am: ያገባች ሴት ባልዋ በሕይወት ሲኖር ከእርሱ ጋር በሕግ ታስራለችና፤ ባልዋ ቢሞት ግን ስለ ባል ከሆነው ሕግ ተፈትታለች።

verses.en: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.fr: Si donc, du vivant de son mari, elle devient la femme d''un autre homme, elle sera appelée adultère; mais si le mari meurt, elle est affranchie de la loi, de sorte qu''elle n''est point adultère en devenant la femme d''un autre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ባልዋ በሕይወት ሳለ ለሌላ ወንድ ብትሆን አመንዝራ ትባላለች፤ ባልዋ ቢሞት ግን ከሕጉ አርነት ወጥታለችና ለሌላ ወንድ ብትሆን አመንዝራ አይደለችም።

verses.en: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.fr: De même, mes frères, vous aussi vous avez été, par le corps de Christ, mis à mort en ce qui concerne la loi, pour que vous apparteniez à un autre, à celui qui est ressuscité des morts, afin que nous portions des fruits pour Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲሁ፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በክርስቶስ ሥጋ ለሕግ ተገድላችኋል፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ፍሬ እንድናፈራ፥ እናንተ ለሌላው፥ ከሙታን ለተነሣው፥ ለእርሱ ትሆኑ ዘንድ።

verses.en: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.fr: Car, lorsque nous étions dans la chair, les passions des péchés provoquées par la loi agissaient dans nos membres, de sorte que nous portions des fruits pour la mort.
verses.am: በሥጋ ሳለን በሕግ የሚሆን የኃጢአት መሻት ለሞት ፍሬ ሊያፈራ በብልቶቻችን ይሠራ ነበርና፤

verses.en: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant, nous avons été dégagés de la loi, étant morts à cette loi sous laquelle nous étions retenus, de sorte que nous servons dans un esprit nouveau, et non selon la lettre qui a vieilli.
verses.am: አሁን ግን ለእርሱ ለታሰርንበት ስለ ሞትን፥ ከሕግ ተፈትተናል፥ ስለዚህም በአዲሱ በመንፈስ ኑሮ እንገዛለን እንጂ በአሮጌው በፊደል ኑሮ አይደለም።

verses.en: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
verses.fr: Que dirons-nous donc? La loi est-elle péché? Loin de là! Mais je n''ai connu le péché que par la loi. Car je n''aurais pas connu la convoitise, si la loi n''eût dit: Tu ne convoiteras point.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? ሕግ ኃጢአት ነውን? አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን በሕግ ባይሆን ኃጢአትን ባላወቅሁም ነበር፤ ሕጉ። አትመኝ ባላለ ምኞትን ባላወቅሁም ነበርና።

verses.en: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
verses.fr: Et le péché, saisissant l''occasion, produisit en moi par le commandement toutes sortes de convoitises; car sans loi le péché est mort.
verses.am: ኃጢአት ግን ምክንያት አግኝቶ ምኞትን ሁሉ በትእዛዝ ሠራብኝ፤ ኃጢአት ያለ ሕግ ምውት ነውና።

verses.en: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.fr: Pour moi, étant autrefois sans loi, je vivais; mais quand le commandement vint, le péché reprit vie, et moi je mourus.
verses.am: እኔም ዱሮ ያለ ሕግ ሕያው ነበርሁ፤ ትእዛዝ በመጣች ጊዜ ግን ኃጢአት ሕያው ሆነ እኔም ሞትሁ፤

verses.en: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
verses.fr: Ainsi, le commandement qui conduit à la vie se trouva pour moi conduire à la mort.
verses.am: ለሕይወትም የተሰጠችውን ትእዛዝ እርስዋን ለሞት ሆና አገኘኋት፤

verses.en: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
verses.fr: Car le péché saisissant l''occasion, me séduisit par le commandement, et par lui me fit mourir.
verses.am: ኃጢአት ምክንያት አግኝቶ በትእዛዝ አታሎኛልና በእርስዋም ገድሎኛል።

verses.en: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.fr: La loi donc est sainte, et le commandement est saint, juste et bon.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሕጉ ቅዱስ ነው ትእዛዚቱም ቅድስትና ጻድቅት በጎም ናት።

verses.en: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.fr: Ce qui est bon a-t-il donc été pour moi une cause de mort? Loin de là! Mais c''est le péché, afin qu''il se manifestât comme péché en me donnant la mort par ce qui est bon, et que, par le commandement, il devînt condamnable au plus haut point.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በጎ የሆነው ነገር ለእኔ ሞት ሆነብኝን? አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ኃጢአት ሆነ፤ ኃጢአትም በትእዛዝ ምክንያት ያለ ልክ ኃጢአተኛ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ ኃጢአትም እንዲሆን ይገለጥ ዘንድ በጎ በሆነው ነገር ለእኔ ሞትን ይሠራ ነበር።

verses.en: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.fr: Nous savons, en effet, que la loi est spirituelle; mais moi, je suis charnel, vendu au péché.
verses.am: ሕግ መንፈሳዊ እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለንና፤ እኔ ግን ከኃጢአት በታች ልሆን የተሸጥሁ የሥጋ ነኝ።

verses.en: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
verses.fr: Car je ne sais pas ce que je fais: je ne fais point ce que je veux, et je fais ce que je hais.
verses.am: የማደርገውን አላውቅምና፤ የምጠላውን ያን አደርጋለሁና ዳሩ ግን የምወደውን እርሱን አላደርገውም።

verses.en: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
verses.fr: Or, si je fais ce que je ne veux pas, je reconnais par là que la loi est bonne.
verses.am: የማልወደውን ግን የማደርግ ከሆንሁ ሕግ መልካም እንደ ሆነ እመሰክራለሁ።

verses.en: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.fr: Et maintenant ce n''est plus moi qui le fais, mais c''est le péché qui habite en moi.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ከሆነ ያን የማደርገው አሁን እኔ አይደለሁም፥ በእኔ የሚያድር ኃጢአት ነው እንጂ።

verses.en: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.fr: Ce qui est bon, je le sais, n''habite pas en moi, c''est-à-dire dans ma chair: j''ai la volonté, mais non le pouvoir de faire le bien.
verses.am: በእኔ ማለት በሥጋዬ በጎ ነገር እንዳይኖር አውቃለሁና፤ ፈቃድ አለኝና፥ መልካሙን ግን ማድረግ የለኝም።

verses.en: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.fr: Car je ne fais pas le bien que je veux, et je fais le mal que je ne veux pas.
verses.am: የማልወደውን ክፉን ነገር አደርጋለሁና ዳሩ ግን የምወደውን በጎውን ነገር አላደርገውም።

verses.en: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.fr: Et si je fais ce que je ne veux pas, ce n''est plus moi qui le fais, c''est le péché qui habite en moi.
verses.am: የማልወደውን የማደርግ ከሆንሁ ግን ያን የማደርገው አሁን እኔ አይደለሁም፥ በእኔ የሚኖር ኃጢአት ነው እንጂ።

verses.en: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.fr: Je trouve donc en moi cette loi: quand je veux faire le bien, le mal est attaché à moi.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ መልካሙን አደርግ ዘንድ ስወድ በእኔ ክፉ እንዲያድርብኝ ሕግን አገኛለሁ።

verses.en: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.fr: Car je prends plaisir à la loi de Dieu, selon l''homme intérieur;
verses.am: በውስጡ ሰውነቴ በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ደስ ይለኛልና፥

verses.en: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.fr: mais je vois dans mes membres une autre loi, qui lutte contre la loi de mon entendement, et qui me rend captif de la loi du péché, qui est dans mes membres.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በብልቶቼ ከአእምሮዬ ሕግ ጋር የሚዋጋውንና በብልቶቼ ባለ በኃጢአት ሕግ የሚማርከኝን ሌላ ሕግ አያለሁ።

verses.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.fr: Misérable que je suis! Qui me délivrera du corps de cette mort?...
verses.am: እኔ ምንኛ ጎስቋላ ሰው ነኝ! ለዚህ ሞት ከተሰጠ ሰውነት ማን ያድነኛል?

verses.en: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.fr: Grâces soient rendues à Dieu par Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur!... Ainsi donc, moi-même, je suis par l''entendement esclave de la loi de Dieu, et je suis par la chair esclave de la loi du péché.
verses.am: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በጌታችን ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና ይሁን። እንግዲያስ እኔ በአእምሮዬ ለእግዚአብሔር ሕግ፥ በሥጋዬ ግን ለኃጢአት ሕግ እገዛለሁ።

verses.en: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.fr: Il n''y a donc maintenant aucune condamnation pour ceux qui sont en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ላሉት አሁን ኵነኔ የለባቸውም።

verses.en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.fr: En effet, la loi de l''esprit de vie en Jésus-Christ m''a affranchi de la loi du péché et de la mort.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ያለው የሕይወት መንፈስ ሕግ ከኃጢአትና ከሞት ሕግ አርነት አውጥቶኛልና።

verses.en: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.fr: Car chose impossible à la loi, parce que la chair la rendait sans force, -Dieu a condamné le péché dans la chair, en envoyant, à cause du péché, son propre Fils dans une chair semblable à celle du péché,

verses.en: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.fr: et cela afin que la justice de la loi fût accomplie en nous, qui marchons, non selon la chair, mais selon l''esprit.
verses.am: ከሥጋ የተነሣ ስለ ደከመ ለሕግ ያልተቻለውን፥ እግዚአብሔር የገዛ ልጁን በኃጢአተኛ ሥጋ ምሳሌ በኃጢአትም ምክንያት ልኮ አድርጎአልና፤ እንደ መንፈስ ፈቃድ እንጂ እንደ ሥጋ ፈቃድ በባንመላለስ በእኛ የሕግ ትእዛዝ ይፈጸም ዘንድ ኃጢአትን በሥጋ ኰነነ።

verses.en: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.fr: Ceux, en effet, qui vivent selon la chair, s''affectionnent aux choses de la chair, tandis que ceux qui vivent selon l''esprit s''affectionnent aux choses de l''esprit.
verses.am: እንደ ሥጋ ፈቃድ የሚኖሩ የሥጋን ነገር ያስባሉና፥ እንደ መንፈስ ፈቃድ የሚኖሩ ግን የመንፈስን ነገር ያስባሉ።

verses.en: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
verses.fr: Et l''affection de la chair, c''est la mort, tandis que l''affection de l''esprit, c''est la vie et la paix;
verses.am: ስለ ሥጋ ማሰብ ሞት ነውና፥ ስለ መንፈስ ማሰብ ግን ሕይወትና ሰላም ነው።

verses.en: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
verses.fr: car l''affection de la chair est inimitié contre Dieu, parce qu''elle ne se soumet pas à la loi de Dieu, et qu''elle ne le peut même pas.
verses.am: ስለ ሥጋ ማሰብ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጥል ነውና፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ሕግ አይገዛምና፥ መገዛትም ተስኖታል፤

verses.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.fr: Or ceux qui vivent selon la chair ne sauraient plaire à Dieu.
verses.am: በሥጋ ያሉትም እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ሊያሰኙት አይችሉም።

verses.en: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.fr: Pour vous, vous ne vivez pas selon la chair, mais selon l''esprit, si du moins l''Esprit de Dieu habite en vous. Si quelqu''un n''a pas l''Esprit de Christ, il ne lui appartient pas.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእናንተ ዘንድ ቢኖር፥ በመንፈስ እንጂ በሥጋ አይደላችሁም። የክርስቶስ መንፈስ የሌለው ከሆነ ግን ይኸው የእርሱ ወገን አይደለም።

verses.en: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.fr: Et si Christ est en vous, le corps, il est vrai, est mort à cause du péché, mais l''esprit est vie à cause de la justice.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ በእናንተ ውስጥ ቢሆን ሰውነታችሁ በኃጢአት ምክንያት የሞተ ነው፥ መንፈሳችሁ ግን በጽድቅ ምክንያት ሕያው ነው።

verses.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
verses.fr: Et si l''Esprit de celui qui a ressuscité Jésus d''entre les morts habite en vous, celui qui a ressuscité Christ d''entre les morts rendra aussi la vie à vos corps mortels par son Esprit qui habite en vous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያስነሣው የእርሱ መንፈስ በእናንተ ዘንድ ቢኖር፥ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያስነሣው እርሱ በእናንተ በሚኖረው በመንፈሱ፥ ለሚሞተው ሰውነታችሁ ደግሞ ሕይወትን ይሰጠዋል።

verses.en: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, frères, nous ne sommes point redevables à la chair, pour vivre selon la chair.
verses.am: እንግዲህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ዕዳ አለብን፥ እንደ ሥጋ ፈቃድ ግን እንኖር ዘንድ ለሥጋ አይደለም።

verses.en: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.fr: Si vous vivez selon la chair, vous mourrez; mais si par l''Esprit vous faites mourir les actions du corps, vous vivrez,
verses.am: እንደ ሥጋ ፈቃድ ብትኖሩ ትሞቱ ዘንድ አላችሁና፤ በመንፈስ ግን የሰውነትን ሥራ ብትገድሉ በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
verses.fr: car tous ceux qui sont conduits par l''Esprit de Dieu sont fils de Dieu.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ የሚመሩ ሁሉ እነዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸውና።

verses.en: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.fr: Et vous n''avez point reçu un esprit de servitude, pour être encore dans la crainte; mais vous avez reçu un Esprit d''adoption, par lequel nous crions: Abba! Père!
verses.am: አባ አባት ብለን የምንጮኽበትን የልጅነት መንፈስ ተቀበላችሁ እንጂ እንደገና ለፍርሃት የባርነትን መንፈስ አልተቀበላችሁምና።

verses.en: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verses.fr: L''Esprit lui-même rend témoignage à notre esprit que nous sommes enfants de Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች መሆናችንን ያ መንፈስ ራሱ ከመንፈሳችን ጋር ይመሰክራል።

verses.en: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
verses.fr: Or, si nous sommes enfants, nous sommes aussi héritiers: héritiers de Dieu, et cohéritiers de Christ, si toutefois nous souffrons avec lui, afin d''être glorifiés avec lui.
verses.am: ልጆች ከሆንን ወራሾች ደግሞ ነን፤ ማለት የእግዚአብሔር ወራሾች ነን፥ አብረንም ደግሞ እንድንከበር አብረን መከራ ብንቀበል ከክርስቶስ ጋር አብረን ወራሾች ነን።

verses.en: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.fr: J''estime que les souffrances du temps présent ne sauraient être comparées à la gloire à venir qui sera révélée pour nous.
verses.am: ለእኛም ይገለጥ ዘንድ ካለው ክብር ጋር ቢመዛዘን የአሁኑ ዘመን ሥቃይ ምንም እንዳይደለ አስባለሁ።

verses.en: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
verses.fr: Aussi la création attend-elle avec un ardent désir la révélation des fils de Dieu.
verses.am: የፍጥረት ናፍቆት የእግዚአብሔርን ልጆች መገለጥ ይጠባበቃልና።

verses.en: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
verses.fr: Car la création a été soumise à la vanité, -non de son gré, mais à cause de celui qui l''y a soumise, avec l''espérance
verses.am: ፍጥረት ለከንቱነት ተገዝቶአልና፥ በተስፋ ስላስገዛው ነው እንጂ በፈቃዱ አይደለም፤

verses.en: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.fr: qu''elle aussi sera affranchie de la servitude de la corruption, pour avoir part à la liberté de la gloire des enfants de Dieu.
verses.am: ተስፋውም ፍጥረት ራሱ ደግሞ ከጥፋት ባርነት ነፃነት ወጥቶ ለእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ወደሚሆን ክብር ነፃነት እንዲደርስ ነው።

verses.en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.fr: Or, nous savons que, jusqu''à ce jour, la création tout entière soupire et souffre les douleurs de l''enfantement.
verses.am: ፍጥረት ሁሉ እስከ አሁን ድረስ አብሮ በመቃተትና በምጥ መኖሩን እናውቃለንና።

verses.en: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
verses.fr: Et ce n''est pas elle seulement; mais nous aussi, qui avons les prémices de l''Esprit, nous aussi nous soupirons en nous-mêmes, en attendant l''adoption, la rédemption de notre corps.
verses.am: እርሱም ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን የመንፈስ በኵራት ያለን ራሳችን ደግሞ የሰውነታችን ቤዛ የሆነውን ልጅነት እየተጠባበቅን ራሳችን በውስጣችን እንቃትታለን።

verses.en: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
verses.fr: Car c''est en espérance que nous sommes sauvés. Or, l''espérance qu''on voit n''est plus espérance: ce qu''on voit, peut-on l''espérer encore?
verses.am: በተስፋ ድነናልና፤ ነገር ግን ተስፋ የሚደረግበቱ ነገር ቢታይ ተስፋ አይደለም፤ የሚያየውንማ ማን ተስፋ ያደርገዋል?

verses.en: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
verses.fr: Mais si nous espérons ce que nous ne voyons pas, nous l''attendons avec persévérance.
verses.am: የማናየውን ግን ተስፋ ብናደርገው በትዕግሥት እንጠባበቃለን።

verses.en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.fr: De même aussi l''Esprit nous aide dans notre faiblesse, car nous ne savons pas ce qu''il nous convient de demander dans nos prières. Mais l''Esprit lui-même intercède par des soupirs inexprimables;
verses.am: እንዲሁም ደግሞ መንፈስ ድካማችንን ያግዛል፤ እንዴት እንድንጸልይ እንደሚገባን አናውቅምና፥ ነገር ግን መንፈስ ራሱ በማይነገር መቃተት ይማልድልናል፤

verses.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
verses.fr: et celui qui sonde les coeurs connaît quelle est la pensée de l''Esprit, parce que c''est selon Dieu qu''il intercède en faveur des saints.
verses.am: ልብንም የሚመረምረው የመንፈስ አሳብ ምን እንደ ሆነ ያውቃል፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ስለ ቅዱሳን ይማልዳልና።

verses.en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.fr: Nous savons, du reste, que toutes choses concourent au bien de ceux qui aiment Dieu, de ceux qui sont appelés selon son dessein.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ለሚወዱት እንደ አሳቡም ለተጠሩት ነገር ሁሉ ለበጎ እንዲደረግ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.fr: Car ceux qu''il a connus d''avance, il les a aussi prédestinés à être semblables à l''image de son Fils, afin que son Fils fût le premier-né entre plusieurs frères.
verses.am: ልጁ በብዙ ወንድሞች መካከል በኵር ይሆን ዘንድ፥ አስቀድሞ ያወቃቸው የልጁን መልክ እንዲመስሉ አስቀድሞ ደግሞ ወስኖአልና፤

verses.en: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.fr: Et ceux qu''il a prédestinés, il les a aussi appelés; et ceux qu''il a appelés, il les a aussi justifiés; et ceux qu''il a justifiés, il les a aussi glorifiés.
verses.am: አስቀድሞም የወሰናቸውን እነዚህን ደግሞ ጠራቸው፤ የጠራቸውንም እነዚህን ደግሞ አጸደቃቸው፤ ያጸደቃቸውንም እነዚህን ደግሞ አከበራቸው።

verses.en: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
verses.fr: Que dirons-nous donc à l''égard de ces choses? Si Dieu est pour nous, qui sera contre nous?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ስለዚህ ነገር ምን እንላለን? እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ከሆነ ማን ይቃወመናል?

verses.en: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.fr: Lui, qui n''a point épargné son propre Fils, mais qui l''a livré pour nous tous, comment ne nous donnera-t-il pas aussi toutes choses avec lui?
verses.am: ለገዛ ልጁ ያልራራለት ነገር ግን ስለ ሁላችን አሳልፎ የሰጠው ያው ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ ሁሉን ነገር እንዲያው እንዴት አይሰጠንም?

verses.en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
verses.fr: Qui accusera les élus de Dieu? C''est Dieu qui justifie!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የመረጣቸውን ማን ይከሳቸዋል? የሚያጸድቅ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ የሚኰንንስ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.fr: Qui les condamnera? Christ est mort; bien plus, il est ressuscité, il est à la droite de Dieu, et il intercède pour nous!
verses.am: የሞተው፥ ይልቁንም ከሙታን የተነሣው፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ያለው፥ ደግሞ ስለ እኛ የሚማልደው ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ነው።

verses.en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.fr: Qui nous séparera de l''amour de Christ? Sera-ce la tribulation, ou l''angoisse, ou la persécution, ou la faim, ou la nudité, ou le péril, ou l''épée?
verses.am: ከክርስቶስ ፍቅር ማን ይለየናል? መከራ፥ ወይስ ጭንቀት፥ ወይስ ስደት፥ ወይስ ራብ፥ ወይስ ራቁትነት፥ ወይስ ፍርሃት፥ ወይስ ሰይፍ ነውን?

verses.en: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: C''est à cause de toi qu''on nous met à mort tout le jour, Qu''on nous regarde comme des brebis destinées à la boucherie.
verses.am: ስለ አንተ ቀኑን ሁሉ እንገደላለን፥ እንደሚታረዱ በጎች ተቆጠርን ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ነው።

verses.en: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.fr: Mais dans toutes ces choses nous sommes plus que vainqueurs par celui qui nous a aimés.
verses.am: በዚህ ሁሉ ግን በወደደን በእርሱ ከአሸናፊዎች እንበልጣለን።

verses.en: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.fr: Car j''ai l''assurance que ni la mort ni la vie, ni les anges ni les dominations, ni les choses présentes ni les choses à venir, ni les puissances,
verses.am: ሞት ቢሆን፥ ሕይወትም ቢሆን፥ መላእክትም ቢሆኑ፥ ግዛትም ቢሆን፥ ያለውም ቢሆን፥ የሚመጣውም ቢሆን፥ ኃይላትም ቢሆኑ፥

verses.en: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.fr: ni la hauteur, ni la profondeur, ni aucune autre créature ne pourra nous séparer de l''amour de Dieu manifesté en Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur.
verses.am: ከፍታም ቢሆን፥ ዝቅታም ቢሆን፥ ልዩ ፍጥረትም ቢሆን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በጌታችን ካለ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ሊለየን እንዳይችል ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
verses.fr: Je dis la vérité en Christ, je ne mens point, ma conscience m''en rend témoignage par le Saint-Esprit:
verses.am: ብዙ ኀዘን የማያቋርጥም ጭንቀት በልቤ አለብኝ ስል በክርስቶስ ሆኜ እውነትን እናገራለሁ፤

verses.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
verses.fr: J''éprouve une grande tristesse, et j''ai dans le coeur un chagrin continuel.
verses.am: አልዋሽምም፤ ሕሊናዬም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ይመሰክርልኛል።

verses.en: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
verses.fr: Car je voudrais moi-même être anathème et séparé de Christ pour mes frères, mes parents selon la chair,
verses.am: በሥጋ ዘመዶቼ ስለ ሆኑ ስለ ወንድሞቼ ከክርስቶስ ተለይቼ እኔ ራሴ የተረገምሁ እንድሆን እጸልይ ነበርና።

verses.en: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
verses.fr: qui sont Israélites, à qui appartiennent l''adoption, et la gloire, et les alliances, et la loi, et le culte, et les promesses,
verses.am: እነርሱ እስራኤላውያን ናቸውና፥ ልጅነትና ክብር ኪዳንም የሕግም መሰጠት የመቅደስም ሥርዓት የተስፋውም ቃላት ለእነርሱ ናቸውና፤

verses.en: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.fr: et les patriarches, et de qui est issu, selon la chair, le Christ, qui est au-dessus de toutes choses, Dieu béni éternellement. Amen!
verses.am: አባቶችም ለእነርሱ ናቸውና፤ ከእነርሱም ክርስቶስ በሥጋ መጣ፥ እርሱም ከሁሉ በላይ ሆኖ ለዘላለም የተባረከ አምላክ ነው፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
verses.fr: Ce n''est point à dire que la parole de Dieu soit restée sans effet. Car tous ceux qui descendent d''Israël ne sont pas Israël,
verses.am: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የተሻረ አይደለም። እነዚህ ከእስራኤል የሚወለዱ ሁሉ እስራኤል አይደሉምና፤ የአብርሃምም ዘር ስለሆኑ ሁላቸው ልጆች አይደሉም፥

verses.en: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.fr: et, pour être la postérité d''Abraham, ils ne sont pas tous ses enfants; mais il est dit: En Isaac sera nommée pour toi une postérité,
verses.am: ነገር ግን። በይስሐቅ ዘር ይጠራልሃል ተባለ።

verses.en: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
verses.fr: c''est-à-dire que ce ne sont pas les enfants de la chair qui sont enfants de Dieu, mais que ce sont les enfants de la promesse qui sont regardés comme la postérité.
verses.am: ይህም፥ የተስፋ ቃል ልጆች ዘር ሆነው ይቆጠራሉ እንጂ እነዚህ የሥጋ ልጆች የሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች አይደሉም ማለት ነው።

verses.en: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.fr: Voici, en effet, la parole de la promesse: Je reviendrai à cette même époque, et Sara aura un fils.
verses.am: ይህ። በዚህ ጊዜ እመጣለሁ ለሳራም ልጅ ይሆንላታል የሚል የተስፋ ቃል ነውና።

verses.en: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
