verses.fr: Et, de plus, il en fut ainsi de Rébecca, qui conçut du seul Isaac notre père;
verses.am: ይህ ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ርብቃ ደግሞ ከአንዱ ከአባታችን ከይስሐቅ በፀነሰች ጊዜ፥

verses.en: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
verses.fr: car, quoique les enfants ne fussent pas encore nés et qu''ils n''eussent fait ni bien ni mal, -afin que le dessein d''élection de Dieu subsistât, sans dépendre des oeuvres, et par la seule volonté de celui qui appelle, -
verses.am: ልጆቹ ገና ሳይወለዱ፥ በጎ ወይም ክፉ ምንም ሳያደርጉ፥ ከጠሪው እንጂ ከሥራ ሳይሆን በምርጫ የሚሆን የእግዚአብሔር አሳብ ይጸና ዘንድ፥

verses.en: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
verses.fr: il fut dit à Rébecca: L''aîné sera assujetti au plus jeune;
verses.am: ለእርስዋ። ታላቁ ለታናሹ ይገዛል ተባለላት።

verses.en: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: J''ai aimé Jacob Et j''ai haï Esaü.
verses.am: ያዕቆብን ወደድሁ ኤሳውን ግን ጠላሁ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ነው።

verses.en: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
verses.fr: Que dirons-nous donc? Y a-t-il en Dieu de l''injustice? Loin de là!
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ዓመፃ አለ ወይ? አይደለም።

verses.en: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.fr: Car il dit à Moïse: Je ferai miséricorde à qui je fais miséricorde, et j''aurai compassion de qui j''ai compassion.
verses.am: ለሙሴ። የምምረውን ሁሉ እምረዋለሁ ለምራራለትም ሁሉ እራራለታለሁ ይላልና።

verses.en: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, cela ne dépend ni de celui qui veut, ni de celui qui court, mais de Dieu qui fait miséricorde.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምሕረት ለወደደ ወይም ለሮጠ አይደለም፥ ከሚምር ከእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ።

verses.en: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.fr: Car l''Ecriture dit à Pharaon: Je t''ai suscité à dessein pour montrer en toi ma puissance, et afin que mon nom soit publié par toute la terre.
verses.am: መጽሐፍ ፈርዖንን። ኃይሌን በአንተ አሳይ ዘንድ ስሜም በምድር ሁሉ ይነገር ዘንድ ለዚህ አስነሣሁህ ይላልና።

verses.en: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.fr: Ainsi, il fait miséricorde à qui il veut, et il endurcit qui il veut.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የሚወደውን ይምረዋል፥ የሚወደውንም እልከኛ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
verses.fr: Tu me diras: Pourquoi blâme-t-il encore? Car qui est-ce qui résiste à sa volonté?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ስለ ምን እስከ አሁን ድረስ ይነቅፋል? ፈቃዱንስ የሚቃወም ማን ነው? ትለኝ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
verses.fr: O homme, toi plutôt, qui es-tu pour contester avec Dieu? Le vase d''argile dira-t-il à celui qui l''a formé: Pourquoi m''as-tu fait ainsi?
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ አንተ ሰው ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር የምትመልስ ማን ነህ? ሥራ ሠሪውን። ስለ ምን እንዲህ አድርገህ ሠራኸኝ ይለዋልን?

verses.en: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
verses.fr: Le potier n''est-il pas maître de l''argile, pour faire avec la même masse un vase d''honneur et un vase d''un usage vil?
verses.am: ወይም ሸክላ ሠሪ ከአንዱ ጭቃ ክፍል አንዱን ዕቃ ለክብር አንዱንም ለውርደት ሊሠራ በጭቃ ላይ ሥልጣን የለውምን?

verses.en: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
verses.fr: Et que dire, si Dieu, voulant montrer sa colère et faire connaître sa puissance, a supporté avec une grande patience des vases de colère formés pour la perdition,
verses.am: የምሕረቱ ዕቃዎችም ከአይሁድ ብቻ አይደሉም፥ ነገር ግን ከአሕዛብ ደግሞ የጠራን እኛ ነን።

verses.en: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
verses.fr: et s''il a voulu faire connaître la richesse de sa gloire envers des vases de miséricorde qu''il a d''avance préparés pour la gloire?
verses.am: የምሕረቱ ዕቃዎችም ከአይሁድ ብቻ አይደሉም፥ ነገር ግን ከአሕዛብ ደግሞ የጠራን እኛ ነን።

verses.en: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.fr: Ainsi nous a-t-il appelés, non seulement d''entre les Juifs, mais encore d''entre les païens,
verses.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ በሆሴዕ። ሕዝቤ ያልሆነውን ሕዝቤ ብዬ፥ ያልተወደደችውንም የተወደደችው ብዬ እጠራለሁ፤

verses.en: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
verses.fr: selon qu''il le dit dans Osée: J''appellerai mon peuple celui qui n''était pas mon peuple, et bien-aimée celle qui n''était pas la bien-aimée;
verses.am: እናንተ ሕዝቤ አይደላችሁም በተባለላቸውም ስፍራ በዚያ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ልጆች ተብለው ይጠራሉ ይላል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
verses.fr: et là où on leur disait: Vous n''êtes pas mon peuple! ils seront appelés fils du Dieu vivant.
verses.am: ኢሳይያስም እንደዚሁ። ጌታ ፀባዖት ዘር ባላስቀረልን እንደ ሰዶም በሆንን ገሞራንም በመሰልን ነበር ብሎ አስቀድሞ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
verses.fr: Esaïe, de son côté, s''écrie au sujet d''Israël: Quand le nombre des fils d''Israël serait comme le sable de la mer, Un reste seulement sera sauvé.
verses.am: ኢሳይያስም እንደዚሁ። ጌታ ፀባዖት ዘር ባላስቀረልን እንደ ሰዶም በሆንን ገሞራንም በመሰልን ነበር ብሎ አስቀድሞ ተናገረ።

verses.en: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
verses.fr: Car le Seigneur exécutera pleinement et promptement sur la terre ce qu''il a résolu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? ጽድቅን ያልተከተሉት አሕዛብ ጽድቅን አገኙ፥ እርሱ ግን ከእምነት የሆነ ጽድቅ ነው፤

verses.en: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
verses.fr: Et, comme Esaïe l''avait dit auparavant: Si le Seigneur des armées Ne nous eût laissé une postérité, Nous serions devenus comme Sodome, Nous aurions été semblables à Gomorrhe.
verses.am: እስራኤል ግን የጽድቅን ሕግ እየተከተሉ ወደ ሕግ አልደረሱም።

verses.en: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
verses.fr: Que dirons-nous donc? Les païens, qui ne cherchaient pas la justice, ont obtenu la justice, la justice qui vient de la foi,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን እንላለን? ጽድቅን ያልተከተሉት አሕዛብ ጽድቅን አገኙ፥ እርሱ ግን ከእምነት የሆነ ጽድቅ ነው፤

verses.en: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.fr: tandis qu''Israël, qui cherchait une loi de justice, n''est pas parvenu à cette loi.
verses.am: እስራኤል ግን የጽድቅን ሕግ እየተከተሉ ወደ ሕግ አልደረሱም።

verses.en: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
verses.fr: Pourquoi? Parce qu''Israël l''a cherchée, non par la foi, mais comme provenant des oeuvres. Ils se sont heurtés contre la pierre d''achoppement,

verses.en: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: Voici, je mets en Sion une pierre d''achoppement Et un rocher de scandale, Et celui qui croit en lui ne sera point confus.
verses.am: ይህስ ስለ ምንድር ነው? በሥራ እንጂ በእምነት ጽድቅን ስላልተከተሉ ነው፤ እነሆ፥ በጽዮን የእንቅፋት ድንጋይና የማሰናከያ ዓለት አኖራለሁ በእርሱም የሚያምን አያፍርም ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ በእንቅፋት ድንጋይ ተሰናከሉ።

verses.en: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
verses.fr: Frères, le voeu de mon coeur et ma prière à Dieu pour eux, c''est qu''ils soient sauvés.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የልቤ በጎ ፈቃድና ስለ እስራኤል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ልመናዬ እንዲድኑ ነው።

verses.en: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.fr: Je leur rends le témoignage qu''ils ont du zèle pour Dieu, mais sans intelligence:
verses.am: በእውቀት አይቅኑ እንጂ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲቀኑ እመሰክርላቸዋለሁና።

verses.en: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
verses.fr: ne connaissant pas la justice de Dieu, et cherchant à établir leur propre justice, ils ne se sont pas soumis à la justice de Dieu;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ጽድቅ ሳያውቁ የራሳቸውንም ጽድቅ ሊያቆሙ ሲፈልጉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ አልተገዙም።

verses.en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
verses.fr: car Christ est la fin de la loi, pour la justification de tous ceux qui croient.
verses.am: የሚያምኑ ሁሉ ይጸድቁ ዘንድ ክርስቶስ የሕግ ፍጻሜ ነውና።

verses.en: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
verses.fr: En effet, Moïse définit ainsi la justice qui vient de la loi: L''homme qui mettra ces choses en pratique vivra par elles.
verses.am: ሙሴ ከሕግ የሆነውን ጽድቅ የሚያደርገው ሰው በእርሱ በሕይወት እንዲኖር ጽፎአልና።

verses.en: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
verses.fr: Mais voici comment parle la justice qui vient de la foi: Ne dis pas en ton coeur: Qui montera au ciel? c''est en faire descendre Christ;
verses.am: ከእምነት የሆነ ጽድቅ ግን እንዲህ ይላል። በልብህ። ማን ወደ ሰማይ ይወጣል? አትበል፤ ይህ ክርስቶስን ለማውረድ ነው፤

verses.en: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
verses.fr: ou: Qui descendra dans l''abîme? c''est faire remonter Christ d''entre les morts.
verses.am: ወይም። በልብህ። ወደ ጥልቁ ማን ይወርዳል? አትበል፤ ይህ ክርስቶስን ከሙታን ለማውጣት ነው።

verses.en: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
verses.fr: Que dit-elle donc? La parole est près de toi, dans ta bouche et dans ton coeur. Or, c''est la parole de la foi, que nous prêchons.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ምን ይላል? በአፍህ በልብህም ሆኖ ቃሉ ቀርቦልሃል፤ ይህም የምንሰብከው የእምነት ቃል ነው።

verses.en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.fr: Si tu confesses de ta bouche le Seigneur Jésus, et si tu crois dans ton coeur que Dieu l''a ressuscité des morts, tu seras sauvé.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ጌታ እንደ ሆነ በአፍህ ብትመሰክር እግዚአብሔርም ከሙታን እንዳስነሣው በልብህ ብታምን ትድናለህና፤

verses.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.fr: Car c''est en croyant du coeur qu''on parvient à la justice, et c''est en confessant de la bouche qu''on parvient au salut,
verses.am: ሰው በልቡ አምኖ ይጸድቃልና በአፉም መስክሮ ይድናልና።

verses.en: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.fr: selon ce que dit l''Ecriture: Quiconque croit en lui ne sera point confus.
verses.am: መጽሐፍ። በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ አያፍርም ይላልና።

verses.en: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
verses.fr: Il n''y a aucune différence, en effet, entre le Juif et le Grec, puisqu''ils ont tous un même Seigneur, qui est riche pour tous ceux qui l''invoquent.
verses.am: በአይሁዳዊና በግሪክ ሰው መካከል ልዩነት የለምና፤ አንዱ ጌታ የሁሉ ጌታ ነውና፥ ለሚጠሩትም ሁሉ ባለ ጠጋ ነው፤

verses.en: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.fr: Car quiconque invoquera le nom du Seigneur sera sauvé.
verses.am: የጌታን ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ይድናልና።

verses.en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.fr: Comment donc invoqueront-ils celui en qui ils n''ont pas cru? Et comment croiront-ils en celui dont ils n''ont pas entendu parler? Et comment en entendront-ils parler, s''il n''y a personne qui prêche?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ያላመኑበትን እንዴት አድርገው ይጠሩታል? ባልሰሙትስ እንዴት ያምናሉ? ያለ ሰባኪስ እንዴት ይሰማሉ?

verses.en: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.fr: Et comment y aura-t-il des prédicateurs, s''ils ne sont pas envoyés? selon qu''il est écrit: Qu''ils sont beaux Les pieds de ceux qui annoncent la paix, De ceux qui annoncent de bonnes nouvelles!
verses.am: መልካሙን የምሥራች የሚያወሩ እግሮቻቸው እንዴት ያማሩ ናቸው ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ካልተላኩ እንዴት ይሰብካሉ?

verses.en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
verses.fr: Mais tous n''ont pas obéi à la bonne nouvelle. Aussi Esaïe dit-il: Seigneur, Qui a cru à notre prédication?
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁሉ ለምሥራቹ ቃል አልታዘዙም። ኢሳይያስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ምስክርነታችንን ማን አመነ? ብሎአልና።

verses.en: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.fr: Ainsi la foi vient de ce qu''on entend, et ce qu''on entend vient de la parole de Christ.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ እምነት ከመስማት ነው መስማትም በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።

verses.en: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.fr: Mais je dis: N''ont-ils pas entendu? Au contraire! Leur voix est allée par toute la terre, Et leurs paroles jusqu''aux extrémités du monde.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን። ባይሰሙ ነው ወይ? እላለሁ። በእውነት። ድምፃቸው በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ቃላቸውም እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ ወጣ።

verses.en: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
verses.fr: Mais je dis: Israël ne l''a-t-il pas su? Moïse le premier dit: J''exciterai votre jalousie par ce qui n''est point une nation, je provoquerai votre colère par une nation sans intelligence.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። እስራኤል ባያውቁ ነው ወይ? እላለሁ። ሙሴ አስቀድሞ። እኔ ሕዝብ በማይሆነው አስቀናችኋለሁ በማያስተውልም ሕዝብ አስቆጣችኋለሁ

verses.en: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
verses.fr: Et Esaïe pousse la hardiesse jusqu''à dire: J''ai été trouvé par ceux qui ne me cherchaient pas, Je me suis manifesté à ceux qui ne me demandaient pas.
verses.am: ብሎአል። ኢሳይያስም ደፍሮ። ላልፈለጉኝ ተገኘሁ፥ ላልጠየቁኝም ተገለጥሁ አለ።

verses.en: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
verses.fr: Mais au sujet d''Israël, il dit: J''ai tendu mes mains tout le jour vers un peuple rebelle Et contredisant.
verses.am: ስለ እስራኤል ግን። ቀኑን ሁሉ ወደማይታዘዝና ወደሚቃወም ሕዝብ እጆቼን ዘረጋሁ ይላል።

verses.en: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.fr: Je dis donc: Dieu a-t-il rejeté son peuple? Loin de là! Car moi aussi je suis Israélite, de la postérité d''Abraham, de la tribu de Benjamin.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ጣላቸውን? እላለሁ። አይደለም እኔ ደግሞ እስራኤላዊና ከአብርሃም ዘር ከብንያምም ወገን ነኝና።

verses.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel saying,
verses.fr: Dieu n''a point rejeté son peuple, qu''il a connu d''avance. Ne savez-vous pas ce que l''Ecriture rapporte d''Elie, comment il adresse à Dieu cette plainte contre Israël:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ ያወቃቸውን ሕዝብ አልጣላቸውም። መጽሐፍ ስለ ኤልያስ በተጻፈው የሚለውን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እስራኤልን እንዴት እንደሚከስ፥ አታውቁምን?

verses.en: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.fr: Seigneur, ils ont tué tes prophètes, ils ont renversé tes autels; je suis resté moi seul, et ils cherchent à m''ôter la vie?
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ነቢያትህን ገደሉ መሠዊያዎችህንም አፈረሱ እኔም ብቻዬን ቀረሁ ነፍሴንም ይሹአታል።

verses.en: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
verses.fr: Mais quelle réponse Dieu lui fait-il? Je me suis réservé sept mille hommes, qui n''ont point fléchi le genou devant Baal.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አምላካዊ መልስ ምን አለው? ለበአል ያልሰገዱትን ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ለእኔ አስቀርቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.fr: De même aussi dans le temps présent il y a un reste, selon l''élection de la grâce.
verses.am: እንደዚሁም በአሁን ዘመን ደግሞ በጸጋ የተመረጡ ቅሬታዎች አሉ።

verses.en: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then it is no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.fr: Or, si c''est par grâce, ce n''est plus par les oeuvres; autrement la grâce n''est plus une grâce. Et si c''est par les oeuvres, ce n''est plus une grâce; autrement l''oeuvre n''est plus une oeuvre.
verses.am: በጸጋ ከሆነ ግን ከሥራ መሆኑ ቀርቶአል፤ ጸጋ ያለዚያ ጸጋ መሆኑ ቀርቶአል።

verses.en: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
verses.fr: Quoi donc? Ce qu''Israël cherche, il ne l''a pas obtenu, mais l''élection l''a obtenu, tandis que les autres ont été endurcis,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምንድር ነው? እስራኤል የሚፈልጉትን አላገኙትም፤ የተመረጡት ግን አገኙት፤

verses.en: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: Dieu leur a donné un esprit d''assoupissement, Des yeux pour ne point voir, Et des oreilles pour ne point entendre, Jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ሌሎቹም ደነዘዙ፤ እንዲሁም። ዓይኖቻቸው እንዳያዩ ጆሮቻቸውም እንዳይሰሙ እግዚአብሔር የእንቅልፍ መንፈስን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሰጣቸው ተብሎ ተጽፎአል። ዳዊትም።

verses.en: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.fr: Et David dit: Que leur table soit pour eux un piège, Un filet, une occasion de chute, et une rétribution!
verses.am: ማዕዳቸው ወጥመድና አሽክላ ማሰናከያም ፍዳም ይሁንባቸው፤

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.fr: Que leurs yeux soient obscurcis pour ne point voir, Et tiens leur dos continuellement courbé!
verses.am: ዓይኖቻቸው እንዳያዩ ይጨልሙ፥ ጀርባቸውንም ዘወትር አጉብጥ ብሎአል።

verses.en: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.fr: Je dis donc: Est-ce pour tomber qu''ils ont bronché? Loin de là! Mais, par leur chute, le salut est devenu accessible aux païens, afin qu''ils fussent excités à la jalousie.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። የተሰናከሉ እስኪወድቁ ድረስ ነውን? እላለሁ። አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን እነርሱን ያስቀናቸው ዘንድ በእነርሱ በደል መዳን ለአሕዛብ ሆነ።

verses.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.fr: Or, si leur chute a été la richesse du monde, et leur amoindrissement la richesse des païens, combien plus en sera-t-il ainsi quand ils se convertiront tous.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን በደላቸው ለዓለም ባለ ጠግነት መሸነፋቸውም ለአሕዛብ ባለ ጠግነት ከሆነ፥ ይልቁንስ መሙላታቸው እንዴት ይሆን?

verses.en: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
verses.fr: Je vous le dis à vous, païens: en tant que je suis apôtre des païens, je glorifie mon ministère,
verses.am: የእነርሱ መጣል ለዓለም መታረቅ ከሆነ ከሙታን ከሚመጣ ሕይወት በቀር መመለሳቸው ምን ይሆን?

verses.en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.fr: afin, s''il est possible, d''exciter la jalousie de ceux de ma race, et d''en sauver quelques-uns.
verses.am: የእነርሱ መጣል ለዓለም መታረቅ ከሆነ ከሙታን ከሚመጣ ሕይወት በቀር መመለሳቸው ምን ይሆን?

verses.en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
verses.fr: Car si leur rejet a été la réconciliation du monde, que sera leur réintégration, sinon une vie d''entre les morts?
verses.am: በኵራቱም ቅዱስ ከሆነ ብሆው ደግሞ ቅዱስ ነው፤ ሥሩም ቅዱስ ከሆነ ቅርንጫፎቹ ደግሞ ቅዱሳን ናቸው።

verses.en: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
verses.fr: Or, si les prémices sont saintes, la masse l''est aussi; et si la racine est sainte, les branches le sont aussi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከቅርንጫፎች አንዳንዱ ቢሰበሩ አንተም የበረሀ ወይራ የሆንህ በመካከላቸው ገብተህ ከእነርሱ ጋር የወይራ ዘይት ከሚወጣው ሥር ተካፋይ ከሆንህ፥ በቅርንጫፎች ላይ አትመካ፤

verses.en: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert grafted in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
verses.fr: Mais si quelques-unes des branches ont été retranchées, et si toi, qui étais un olivier sauvage, tu as été enté à leur place, et rendu participant de la racine et de la graisse de l''olivier,
verses.am: ብትመካባቸው ግን ሥሩ አንተን ይሸከምሃል እንጂ ሥሩን የምትሸከም አንተ አይደለህም።

verses.en: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
verses.fr: ne te glorifie pas aux dépens de ces branches. Si tu te glorifies, sache que ce n''est pas toi qui portes la racine, mais que c''est la racine qui te porte.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። እኔ እንድገባ ቅርንጫፎች ተሰበሩ ትል ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.
verses.fr: Tu diras donc: Les branches ont été retranchées, afin que moi je fusse enté.
verses.am: መልካም፤ እነርሱ ከአለማመን የተነሣ ተሰበሩ አንተም ከእምነት የተነሣ ቆመሃል። ፍራ እንጂ የትዕቢትን ነገር አታስብ።

verses.en: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.fr: Cela est vrai; elles ont été retranchées pour cause d''incrédulité, et toi, tu subsistes par la foi. Ne t''abandonne pas à l''orgueil, mais crains;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተፈጠሩት ለነበሩት ቅርንጫፎች የራራላቸው ካልሆነ ለአንተ ደግሞ አይራራልህምና።

verses.en: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
verses.fr: car si Dieu n''a pas épargné les branches naturelles, il ne t''épargnera pas non plus.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነትና ጭከና ተመልከት፤ ጭከናው በወደቁት ላይ ነው፥ በቸርነቱ ግን ጸንተህ ብትኖር የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነት በአንተ ላይ ነው፤ ያለዚያ አንተ ደግሞ ትቆረጣለህ።

verses.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.fr: Considère donc la bonté et la sévérité de Dieu: sévérité envers ceux qui sont tombés, et bonté de Dieu envers toi, si tu demeures ferme dans cette bonté; autrement, tu seras aussi retranché.
verses.am: እነዚያም ደግሞ በአለማመናቸው ጸንተው ባይኖሩ በዛፉ ውስጥ ይገባሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር መልሶ ሊያገባቸው ይችላልና።

verses.en: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.fr: Eux de même, s''ils ne persistent pas dans l''incrédulité, ils seront entés; car Dieu est puissant pour les enter de nouveau.
verses.am: አንተ በፍጥረቱ የበረሀ ከነበረ ወይራ ተቆርጠህ እንደ ፍጥረትህ ሳትሆን በመልካም ወይራ ከገባህ፥ ይልቁንስ እነዚያ በፍጥረታቸው ያሉት ቅርንጫፎች በራሳቸው ወይራ እንዴት አይገቡም?

verses.en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.fr: Si toi, tu as été coupé de l''olivier naturellement sauvage, et enté contrairement à ta nature sur l''olivier franc, à plus forte raison eux seront-ils entés selon leur nature sur leur propre olivier.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ልባሞች የሆናችሁ እንዳይመስላችሁ ይህን ምሥጢር ታውቁ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ፤ የአሕዛብ ሙላት እስኪገባ ድረስ ድንዛዜ በእስራኤል በአንዳንድ በኩል ሆነባቸው፤

verses.en: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
verses.fr: Car je ne veux pas, frères, que vous ignoriez ce mystère, afin que vous ne vous regardiez point comme sages, c''est qu''une partie d''Israël est tombée dans l''endurcissement, jusqu''à ce que la totalité des païens soit entrée.
verses.am: እንደዚሁም እስራኤል ሁሉ ይድናል፤ እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ። መድኃኒት ከጽዮን ይወጣል ከያዕቆብም ኃጢአተኛነትን ያስወግዳል።

verses.en: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.fr: Et ainsi tout Israël sera sauvé, selon qu''il est écrit: Le libérateur viendra de Sion, Et il détournera de Jacob les impiétés;
verses.am: ኃጢአታቸውንም ስወስድላቸው ከእነርሱ ጋር የምገባው ኪዳን ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.fr: Et ce sera mon alliance avec eux, Lorsque j''ôterai leurs péchés.
verses.am: በወንጌልስ በኩል ስለ እናንተ ጠላቶች ናቸው፥ በምርጫ በኩል ግን ስለ አባቶች ተወዳጆች ናቸው፤

verses.en: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the father's sakes.
verses.fr: En ce qui concerne l''Evangile, ils sont ennemis à cause de vous; mais en ce qui concerne l''élection, ils sont aimés à cause de leurs pères.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በጸጋው ስጦታና በመጥራቱ አይጸጸትምና።

verses.en: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
verses.fr: Car Dieu ne se repent pas de ses dons et de son appel.
verses.am: እናንተም ቀድሞ ለእግዚአብሔር እንዳልታዘዛችሁ፥ አሁን ግን ከአለመታዘዛቸው የተነሣ ምሕረት እንዳገኛችሁ፥

verses.en: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
verses.fr: De même que vous avez autrefois désobéi à Dieu et que par leur désobéissance vous avez maintenant obtenu miséricorde,
verses.am: እንዲሁ በተማራችሁበት ምሕረት እነርሱ ደግሞ ምሕረትን ያገኙ ዘንድ እነዚህ ደግሞ አሁን አልታዘዙም።

verses.en: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
verses.fr: de même ils ont maintenant désobéi, afin que, par la miséricorde qui vous a été faite, ils obtiennent aussi miséricorde.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ይምር ዘንድ ሁሉን በአለመታዘዝ ዘግቶታልና።

verses.en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.fr: Car Dieu a renfermé tous les hommes dans la désobéissance, pour faire miséricorde à tous.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ባለ ጠግነትና ጥበብ እውቀቱም እንዴት ጥልቅ ነው፤ ፍርዱ እንዴት የማይመረመር ነው፥ ለመንገዱም ፍለጋ የለውም።

verses.en: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.fr: O profondeur de la richesse, de la sagesse et de la science de Dieu! Que ses jugements sont insondables, et ses voies incompréhensibles! Car
verses.am: የጌታን ልብ ያወቀው ማን ነው?

verses.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.fr: Qui a connu la pensée du Seigneur, Ou qui a été son conseiller?
verses.am: ወይስ አማካሪው ማን ነበር? ወይስ ብድራቱን ይመልስ ዘንድ ለእርሱ አስቀድሞ የሰጠው ማን ነው?

verses.en: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.fr: Qui lui a donné le premier, pour qu''il ait à recevoir en retour?
verses.am: ሁሉ ከእርሱና በእርሱ ለእርሱም ነውና፤ ለእርሱ ለዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.fr: C''est de lui, par lui, et pour lui que sont toutes choses. A lui la gloire dans tous les siècles! Amen!
verses.am: ሁሉ ከእርሱና በእርሱ ለእርሱም ነውና፤ ለእርሱ ለዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.fr: Je vous exhorte donc, frères, par les compassions de Dieu, à offrir vos corps comme un sacrifice vivant, saint, agréable à Dieu, ce qui sera de votre part un culte raisonnable.
verses.am: እንግዲህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሰውነታችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኝና ሕያው ቅዱስም መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ ታቀርቡ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ርኅራኄ እለምናችኋለሁ፥ እርሱም ለአእምሮ የሚመች አገልግሎታችሁ ነው።

verses.en: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.fr: Ne vous conformez pas au siècle présent, mais soyez transformés par le renouvellement de l''intelligence, afin que vous discerniez quelle est la volonté de Dieu, ce qui est bon, agréable et parfait.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ እርሱም በጎና ደስ የሚያሰኝ ፍጹምም የሆነው ነገር ምን እንደ ሆነ ፈትናችሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ በልባችሁ መታደስ ተለወጡ እንጂ ይህን ዓለም አትምሰሉ።

verses.en: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
verses.fr: Par la grâce qui m''a été donnée, je dis à chacun de vous de n''avoir pas de lui-même une trop haute opinion, mais de revêtir des sentiments modestes, selon la mesure de foi que Dieu a départie à chacun.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእያንዳንዱ የእምነትን መጠን እንዳካፈለው፥ እንደ ባለ አእምሮ እንዲያስብ እንጂ ማሰብ ከሚገባው አልፎ በትዕቢት እንዳያስብ በመካከላችሁ ላለው ለእያንዳንዱ በተሰጠኝ ጸጋ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.fr: Car, comme nous avons plusieurs membres dans un seul corps, et que tous les membres n''ont pas la même fonction,
verses.am: በአንድ አካል ብዙ ብልቶች እንዳሉን፥ የብልቶቹም ሁሉ ሥራ አንድ እንዳይደለ፥

verses.en: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
verses.fr: ainsi, nous qui sommes plusieurs, nous formons un seul corps en Christ, et nous sommes tous membres les uns des autres.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ብዙዎች ስንሆን በክርስቶስ አንድ አካል ነን፥ እርስ በርሳችንም እያንዳንዳችን የሌላው ብልቶች ነን።

verses.en: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
verses.fr: Puisque nous avons des dons différents, selon la grâce qui nous a été accordée, que celui qui a le don de prophétie l''exerce selon l''analogie de la foi;
verses.am: እንደ ተሰጠንም ጸጋ ልዩ ልዩ ስጦታ አለን፤ ትንቢት ቢሆን እንደ እምነታችን መጠን ትንቢት እንናገር፤

verses.en: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
verses.fr: que celui qui est appelé au ministère s''attache à son ministère; que celui qui enseigne s''attache à son enseignement,
verses.am: አገልግሎት ቢሆን በአገልግሎታችን እንትጋ፤ የሚያስተምርም ቢሆን በማስተማሩ ይትጋ፤

verses.en: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.fr: et celui qui exhorte à l''exhortation. Que celui qui donne le fasse avec libéralité; que celui qui préside le fasse avec zèle; que celui qui pratique la miséricorde le fasse avec joie.
verses.am: የሚመክርም ቢሆን በመምከሩ ይትጋ፤ የሚሰጥ በልግስና ይስጥ፤ የሚገዛ በትጋት ይግዛ፤ የሚምር በደስታ ይማር።

verses.en: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.fr: Que la charité soit sans hypocrisie. Ayez le mal en horreur; attachez-vous fortement au bien.
verses.am: ፍቅራችሁ ያለ ግብዝነት ይሁን። ክፉውን ነገር ተጸየፉት፤ ከበጎ ነገር ጋር ተባበሩ፤

verses.en: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
verses.fr: Par amour fraternel, soyez pleins d''affection les uns pour les autres; par honneur, usez de prévenances réciproques.
verses.am: በወንድማማች መዋደድ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተዋደዱ፤ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተከባበሩ፤

verses.en: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.fr: Ayez du zèle, et non de la paresse. Soyez fervents d''esprit. Servez le Seigneur.
verses.am: ለሥራ ከመትጋት አትለግሙ፤ በመንፈስ የምትቃጠሉ ሁኑ፤ ለጌታ ተገዙ፤

verses.en: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.fr: Réjouissez-vous en espérance. Soyez patients dans l''affliction. Persévérez dans la prière.
verses.am: በተስፋ ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ በመከራ ታገሡ፤ በጸሎት ጽኑ፤

verses.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.fr: Pourvoyez aux besoins des saints. Exercez l''hospitalité.
verses.am: ቅዱሳንን በሚያስፈልጋቸው እርዱ፤ እንግዶችን ለመቀበል ትጉ።

verses.en: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.fr: Bénissez ceux qui vous persécutent, bénissez et ne maudissez pas.
verses.am: የሚያሳድዱአችሁን መርቁ፥ መርቁ እንጂ አትርገሙ።

verses.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.fr: Réjouissez-vous avec ceux qui se réjouissent; pleurez avec ceux qui pleurent.
verses.am: ደስ ከሚላቸው ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ከሚያለቅሱም ጋር አልቅሱ።

verses.en: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.fr: Ayez les mêmes sentiments les uns envers les autres. N''aspirez pas à ce qui est élevé, mais laissez-vous attirer par ce qui est humble. Ne soyez point sages à vos propres yeux.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁ በአንድ አሳብ ተስማሙ፤ የትዕቢትን ነገር አታስቡ፥ ነገር ግን የትሕትናን ነገር ለመሥራት ትጉ። ልባሞች የሆናችሁ አይምሰላችሁ።

verses.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.fr: Ne rendez à personne le mal pour le mal. Recherchez ce qui est bien devant tous les hommes.
verses.am: ለማንም ስለ ክፉ ፈንታ ክፉን አትመልሱ፤ በሰው ሁሉ ፊት መልካም የሆነውን አስቡ።

verses.en: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.fr: S''il est possible, autant que cela dépend de vous, soyez en paix avec tous les hommes.
verses.am: ቢቻላችሁስ በእናንተ በኩል ከሰው ሁሉ ጋር በሰላም ኑሩ።

verses.en: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ne vous vengez point vous-mêmes, bien-aimés, mais laissez agir la colère; car il est écrit: A moi la vengeance, à moi la rétribution, dit le Seigneur.
verses.am: ተወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ራሳችሁ አትበቀሉ፥ ለቍጣው ፈንታ ስጡ እንጂ፤ በቀል የእኔ ነው፥ እኔ ብድራቱን እመልሳለሁ ይላል ጌታ ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና።

verses.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.fr: Mais si ton ennemi a faim, donne-lui à manger; s''il a soif, donne-lui à boire; car en agissant ainsi, ce sont des charbons ardents que tu amasseras sur sa tête.
verses.am: ጠላትህ ግን ቢራብ አብላው፤ ቢጠማ አጠጣው፤ ይህን በማድረግህ በራሱ ላይ የእሳት ፍም ትከምራለህና።

verses.en: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.fr: Ne te laisse pas vaincre par le mal, mais surmonte le mal par le bien.
verses.am: ክፉውን በመልካም አሸንፍ እንጂ በክፉ አትሸነፍ።

verses.en: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
verses.fr: Que toute personne soit soumise aux autorités supérieures; car il n''y a point d''autorité qui ne vienne de Dieu, et les autorités qui existent ont été instituées de Dieu.
verses.am: ነፍስ ሁሉ በበላይ ላሉት ባለ ሥልጣኖች ይገዛ። ከእግዚአብሔር ካልተገኘ በቀር ሥልጣን የለምና፤ ያሉትም ባለ ሥልጣኖች በእግዚአብሔር የተሾሙ ናቸው።

verses.en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi celui qui s''oppose à l''autorité résiste à l''ordre que Dieu a établi, et ceux qui résistent attireront une condamnation sur eux-mêmes.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ባለ ሥልጣንን የሚቃወም የእግዚአብሔርን ሥርዓት ይቃወማል፤ የሚቃወሙትም በራሳቸው ላይ ፍርድን ይቀበላሉ።

verses.en: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas pour une bonne action, c''est pour une mauvaise, que les magistrats sont à redouter. Veux-tu ne pas craindre l''autorité? Fais-le bien, et tu auras son approbation.
verses.am: ገዥዎች ለክፉ አድራጊዎች እንጂ መልካም ለሚያደርጉ የሚያስፈሩ አይደሉምና። ባለ ሥልጣንን እንዳትፈራ ትወዳለህን? መልካሙን አድርግ ከእርሱም ምስጋና ይሆንልሃል፤

verses.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
verses.fr: Le magistrat est serviteur de Dieu pour ton bien. Mais si tu fais le mal, crains; car ce n''est pas en vain qu''il porte l''épée, étant serviteur de Dieu pour exercer la vengeance et punir celui qui fait le mal.
verses.am: ለመልካም ነገር ለአንተ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ነውና። በከንቱ ግን ሰይፍ አይታጠቅምና ክፉ ብታደርግ ፍራ፤ ቍጣውን ለማሳየት ክፉ አድራጊውን የሚበቀል የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ ነውና።

verses.en: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
verses.fr: Il est donc nécessaire d''être soumis, non seulement par crainte de la punition, mais encore par motif de conscience.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ስለ ቍጣው ብቻ አይደለም ነገር ግን ስለ ሕሊና ደግሞ መገዛት ግድ ነው።

verses.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
verses.fr: C''est aussi pour cela que vous payez les impôts. Car les magistrats sont des ministres de Dieu entièrement appliqués à cette fonction.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ትገብራላችሁና፤ በዚህ ነገር የሚተጉ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋዮች ናቸውና።

verses.en: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
verses.fr: Rendez à tous ce qui leur est dû: l''impôt à qui vous devez l''impôt, le tribut à qui vous devez le tribut, la crainte à qui vous devez la crainte, l''honneur à qui vous devez l''honneur.
verses.am: ለሁሉ የሚገባውን አስረክቡ፤ ግብር ለሚገባው ግብርን፥ ቀረጥ ለሚገባው ቀረጥን፥ መፈራት ለሚገባው መፈራትን፥ ክብር ለሚገባው ክብርን ስጡ።

verses.en: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verses.fr: Ne devez rien à personne, si ce n''est de vous aimer les uns les autres; car celui qui aime les autres a accompli la loi.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁ ከመዋደድ በቀር ለማንም ዕዳ አይኑርባችሁ፥ ሌላውን የሚወድ ሕግን ፈጽሞታልና።

verses.en: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.fr: En effet, les commandements: Tu ne commettras point d''adultère, tu ne tueras point, tu ne déroberas point, tu ne convoiteras point, et ceux qu''il peut encore y avoir, se résument dans cette parole: Tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même.
verses.am: አታመንዝር፥ አትግደል፥ አትስረቅ፥ በውሸት አትመስክር፥ አትመኝ የሚለው ከሌላይቱ ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ጋር በዚህ። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ነፍስህ ውደድ በሚለው ቃል ተጠቅልሎአል።

verses.en: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.fr: L''amour ne fait point de mal au prochain: l''amour est donc l''accomplissement de la loi.
verses.am: ፍቅር ለባልንጀራው ክፉ አያደርግም፤ ስለዚህ ፍቅር የሕግ ፍጻሜ ነው።

verses.en: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verses.fr: Cela importe d''autant plus que vous savez en quel temps nous sommes: c''est l''heure de vous réveiller enfin du sommeil, car maintenant le salut est plus près de nous que lorsque nous avons cru.
verses.am: ከእንቅልፍ የምትነሡበት ሰዓት አሁን እንደ ደረሰ ዘመኑን እወቁ፤ ካመንንበት ጊዜ ይልቅ መዳናችን ዛሬ ወደ እኛ ቀርቦአልና።

verses.en: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
verses.fr: La nuit est avancée, le jour approche. Dépouillons-nous donc des oeuvres des ténèbres, et revêtons les armes de la lumière.
verses.am: ሌሊቱ አልፎአል፥ ቀኑም ቀርቦአል። እንግዲህ የጨለማውን ሥራ አውጥተን የብርሃንን ጋሻ ጦር እንልበስ።

verses.en: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
verses.fr: Marchons honnêtement, comme en plein jour, loin des excès et de l''ivrognerie, de la luxure et de l''impudicité, des querelles et des jalousies.
verses.am: በቀን እንደምንሆን በአገባብ እንመላለስ፤ በዘፈንና በስካር አይሁን፥ በዝሙትና በመዳራት አይሁን፥ በክርክርና በቅናት አይሁን፤

verses.en: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
verses.fr: Mais revêtez-vous du Seigneur Jésus-Christ, et n''ayez pas soin de la chair pour en satisfaire les convoitises.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጌታን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ልበሱት፤ ምኞቱንም እንዲፈጽም ለሥጋ አታስቡ።

verses.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
verses.fr: Faites accueil à celui qui est faible dans la foi, et ne discutez pas sur les opinions.
verses.am: በእምነት የደከመውንም ተቀበሉት፥ በአሳቡም ላይ አትፍረዱ።

verses.en: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
verses.fr: Tel croit pouvoir manger de tout: tel autre, qui est faible, ne mange que des légumes.
verses.am: ሁሉን ይበላ ዘንድ እንደ ተፈቀደለት የሚያምን አለ፥ ደካማው ግን አትክልት ይበላል።

verses.en: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
verses.fr: Que celui qui mange ne méprise point celui qui ne mange pas, et que celui qui ne mange pas ne juge point celui qui mange, car Dieu l''a accueilli.
verses.am: የሚበላ የማይበላውን አይናቀው የማይበላውም በሚበላው አይፍረድ፥ እግዚአብሔር ተቀብሎታልና።

verses.en: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
verses.fr: Qui es-tu, toi qui juges un serviteur d''autrui? S''il se tient debout, ou s''il tombe, cela regarde son maître. Mais il se tiendra debout, car le Seigneur a le pouvoir de l''affermir.
verses.am: አንተ በሌላው ሎሌ የምትፈርድ ማን ነህ? እርሱ ቢቆም ወይም ቢወድቅ ለገዛ ጌታው ነው፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ሊያቆመው ይችላልና ይቆማል።

verses.en: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
verses.fr: Tel fait une distinction entre les jours; tel autre les estime tous égaux. Que chacun ait en son esprit une pleine conviction.
verses.am: ይህ ሰው አንድ ቀን ከሌላ ቀን እንዲሻል ያስባል፥ ያ ግን ቀን ሁሉ አንድ እንደ ሆነ ያስባል፤ እያንዳንዱ በገዛ አእምሮው አጥብቆ ይረዳ።

verses.en: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
verses.fr: Celui qui distingue entre les jours agit ainsi pour le Seigneur. Celui qui mange, c''est pour le Seigneur qu''il mange, car il rend grâces à Dieu; celui qui ne mange pas, c''est pour le Seigneur qu''il ne mange pas, et il rend grâces à Dieu.
verses.am: ቀንን የሚያከብር ለጌታ ብሎ ያከብራል፤ የሚበላም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናልና ለጌታ ብሎ ይበላል፤ የማይበላም ለጌታ ብሎ አይበላም እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግናል።

verses.en: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
verses.fr: En effet, nul de nous ne vit pour lui-même, et nul ne meurt pour lui-même.
verses.am: ከእኛ አንድ ስንኳ ለራሱ የሚኖር የለምና፥ ለራሱም የሚሞት የለም፤

verses.en: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
verses.fr: Car si nous vivons, nous vivons pour le Seigneur; et si nous mourons, nous mourons pour le Seigneur. Soit donc que nous vivions, soit que nous mourions, nous sommes au Seigneur.
verses.am: በሕይወት ሆነን ብንኖር ለጌታ እንኖራለንና፥ ብንሞትም ለጌታ እንሞታለን። እንግዲህ በሕይወት ሆነን ብንኖር ወይም ብንሞት የጌታ ነን።

verses.en: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
verses.fr: Car Christ est mort et il a vécu, afin de dominer sur les morts et sur les vivants.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ነገር ሙታንንም ሕያዋንንም ይገዛ ዘንድ ክርስቶስ ሞቶአልና ሕያውም ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.fr: Mais toi, pourquoi juges-tu ton frère? ou toi, pourquoi méprises-tu ton frère? puisque nous comparaîtrons tous devant le tribunal de Dieu.
verses.am: አንተም በወንድምህ ላይ ስለ ምን ትፈርዳለህ? ወይስ አንተ ደግሞ ወንድምህን ስለ ምን ትንቃለህ? ሁላችን በክርስቶስ ፍርድ ወንበር ፊት እንቆማለንና።

verses.en: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
verses.fr: Car il est écrit: Je suis vivant, dit le Seigneur, Tout genou fléchira devant moi, Et toute langue donnera gloire à Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ ሕያው ነኝ፥ ይላል ጌታ፥ ጉልበት ሁሉ ለእኔ ይንበረከካል መላስም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና።

verses.en: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.fr: Ainsi chacun de nous rendra compte à Dieu pour lui-même.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ እያንዳንዳችን ስለ ራሳችን ለእግዚአብሔር መልስ እንሰጣለን።

verses.en: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
verses.fr: Ne nous jugeons donc plus les uns les autres; mais pensez plutôt à ne rien faire qui soit pour votre frère une pierre d''achoppement ou une occasion de chute.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እርስ በርሳችን አንፈራረድ፤ ይልቁን ግን ለወንድም እንቅፋትን ወይም ማሰናከያን ማንም እንዳያኖርበት ይህን ቍረጡ።

verses.en: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.fr: Je sais et je suis persuadé par le Seigneur Jésus que rien n''est impur en soi, et qu''une chose n''est impure que pour celui qui la croit impure.
verses.am: በራሱ ርኵስ የሆነ ነገር እንደ ሌለ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ሆኜ አውቄአለሁ ተረድቼአለሁም፤ ነገር ግን ምንም ርኵስ እንዲሆን ለሚቆጥር ለእርሱ ርኵስ ነው።

verses.en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
verses.fr: Mais si, pour un aliment, ton frère est attristé, tu ne marches plus selon l''amour: ne cause pas, par ton aliment, la perte de celui pour lequel Christ est mort.
verses.am: ወንድምህንም በመብል ምክንያት የምታሳዝን ከሆንህ እንግዲህ በፍቅር አልተመላለስህም። ክርስቶስ ስለ እርሱ የሞተለትን እርሱን በመብልህ አታጥፋው።

verses.en: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.fr: Que votre privilège ne soit pas un sujet de calomnie.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ለእናንተ ያለው መልካም ነገር አይሰደብ፤

verses.en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Car le royaume de Dieu, ce n''est pas le manger et le boire, mais la justice, la paix et la joie, par le Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ጽድቅና ሰላም በመንፈስ ቅዱስም የሆነ ደስታ ናት እንጂ መብልና መጠጥ አይደለችምና።

verses.en: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
verses.fr: Celui qui sert Christ de cette manière est agréable à Dieu et approuvé des hommes.
verses.am: እንደዚህ አድርጎ ለክርስቶስ የሚገዛ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኛልና፥ በሰውም ዘንድ የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, recherchons ce qui contribue à la paix et à l''édification mutuelle.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ ሰላም የሚቆምበትን እርስ በርሳችንም የምንታነጽበትን እንከተል።

verses.en: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
verses.fr: Pour un aliment, ne détruis pas l''oeuvre de Dieu. A la vérité toutes choses sont pures; mais il est mal à l''homme, quand il mange, de devenir une pierre d''achoppement.
verses.am: በመብል ምክንያት የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ አታፍርስ። ሁሉ ንጹሕ ነው፥ በመጠራጠር የተበላ እንደ ሆነ ግን ለዚያ ሰው ክፉ ነው።

verses.en: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
verses.fr: Il est bien de ne pas manger de viande, de ne pas boire de vin, et de s''abstenir de ce qui peut être pour ton frère une occasion de chute, de scandale ou de faiblesse.
verses.am: ሥጋን አለመብላት ወይንንም አለመጠጣት ወንድምህም የሚሰናከልበትን አለማድረግ መልካም ነው።

verses.en: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
verses.fr: Cette foi que tu as, garde-la pour toi devant Dieu. Heureux celui qui ne se condamne pas lui-même dans ce qu''il approuve!
verses.am: ለአንተ ያለህ እምነት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለራስህ ይሁንልህ። ፈትኖ መልካም እንዲሆን በሚቈጥረው ነገር በራሱ ላይ የማይፈርድ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.en: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui a des doutes au sujet de ce qu''il mange est condamné, parce qu''il n''agit pas par conviction. Tout ce qui n''est pas le produit d''une conviction est péché.
verses.am: የሚጠራጠረው ግን ቢበላ በእምነት ስላልሆነ ተኮንኖአል፤ በእምነትም ያልሆነ ሁሉ ኃጢአት ነው።

verses.en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.fr: Nous qui sommes forts, nous devons supporter les faiblesses de ceux qui ne le sont pas, et ne pas nous complaire en nous-mêmes.
verses.am: እኛም ኃይለኞች የሆንን የደካሞችን ድካም እንድንሸከም ራሳችንንም ደስ እንዳናሰኝ ይገባናል።

verses.en: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
verses.fr: Que chacun de nous complaise au prochain pour ce qui est bien en vue de l''édification.
verses.am: እያንዳንዳችን እንድናንጸው እርሱን ለመጥቀም ባልንጀራችንን ደስ እናሰኝ።

verses.en: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
verses.fr: Car Christ ne s''est point complu en lui-même, mais, selon qu''il est écrit: Les outrages de ceux qui t''insultent sont tombés sur moi.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ራሱን ደስ አላሰኘምና፤ ነገር ግን። አንተን የነቀፉበት ነቀፋ ወደቀብኝ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ሆነበት።

verses.en: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verses.fr: Or, tout ce qui a été écrit d''avance l''a été pour notre instruction, afin que, par la patience, et par la consolation que donnent les Ecritures, nous possédions l''espérance.
verses.am: በመጽናትና መጻሕፍት በሚሰጡት መጽናናት ተስፋ ይሆንልን ዘንድ አስቀድሞ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ለትምህርታችን ተጽፎአልና።

verses.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
verses.fr: Que le Dieu de la persévérance et de la consolation vous donne d''avoir les mêmes sentiments les uns envers les autres selon Jésus-Christ,

verses.en: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: afin que tous ensemble, d''une seule bouche, vous glorifiiez le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: በአንድ ልብ ሆናችሁ በአንድ አፍ እግዚአብሔርን፥ እርሱም የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አባት፥ ታከብሩ ዘንድ፥ የትዕግሥትና የመጽናናት አምላክ እንደ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ፈቃድ እርስ በርሳችሁ በአንድ አሳብ መሆንን ይስጣችሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
verses.fr: Accueillez-vous donc les uns les autres, comme Christ vous a accueillis, pour la gloire de Dieu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ክርስቶስ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር እንደ ተቀበላችሁ እንዲሁ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተቀባበሉ።

verses.en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
verses.fr: Je dis, en effet, que Christ a été serviteur des circoncis, pour prouver la véracité de Dieu en confirmant les promesses faites aux pères,

verses.en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
verses.fr: tandis que les païens glorifient Dieu à cause de sa miséricorde, selon qu''il est écrit: C''est pourquoi je te louerai parmi les nations, Et je chanterai à la gloire de ton nom.
verses.am: ለአባቶች የተሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል ያጸና ዘንድ ደግሞም። ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ አሕዛብ ስለ ምሕረቱ እግዚአብሔርን ያከብሩ ዘንድ፥ ክርስቶስ ስለ እግዚአብሔር እውነት የመገረዝ አገልጋይ ሆነ እላለሁ።

verses.en: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
verses.fr: Il est dit encore: Nations, réjouissez-vous avec son peuple!
verses.am: ደግሞም። አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ ይላል።

verses.en: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
verses.fr: Et encore: Louez le Seigneur, vous toutes les nations, Célébrez-le, vous tous les peuples!
verses.am: ደግሞም። እናንተ አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ ጌታን አመስግኑ ሕዝቦቹም ሁሉ ይወድሱት ይላል።

verses.en: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.fr: Esaïe dit aussi: Il sortira d''Isaï un rejeton, Qui se lèvera pour régner sur les nations; Les nations espéreront en lui.
verses.am: ደግሞም ኢሳይያስ። የእሴይ ሥር አሕዛብንም ሊገዛ የሚነሣው ይሆናል፤ በእርሱ አሕዛብ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ ይላል።

verses.en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Que le Dieu de l''espérance vous remplisse de toute joie et de toute paix dans la foi, pour que vous abondiez en espérance, par la puissance du Saint-Esprit!
verses.am: የተስፋ አምላክም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኃይል በተስፋ እንድትበዙ በማመናችሁ ደስታንና ሰላምን ሁሉ ይሙላባችሁ።

verses.en: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui vous concerne, mes frères, je suis moi-même persuadé que vous êtes pleins de bonnes dispositions, remplis de toute connaissance, et capables de vous exhorter les uns les autres.
verses.am: እኔም ራሴ ደግሞ፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ በበጎነት ራሳችሁ እንደ ተሞላችሁ፥ እውቀትም ሁሉ እንደ ሞላባችሁ፥ እርስ በርሳችሁም ደግሞ ልትገሠጹ እንዲቻላችሁ ስለ እናንተ ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
verses.fr: Cependant, à certains égards, je vous ai écrit avec une sorte de hardiesse, comme pour réveiller vos souvenirs, à cause de la grâce que Dieu m''a faite
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በሚሆን ነገር በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ትምክህት አለኝ።

verses.en: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: d''être ministre de Jésus-Christ parmi les païens, m''acquittant du divin service de l''Evangile de Dieu, afin que les païens lui soient une offrande agréable, étant sanctifiée par l''Esprit-Saint.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በሚሆን ነገር በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ትምክህት አለኝ።

verses.en: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
verses.fr: J''ai donc sujet de me glorifier en Jésus-Christ, pour ce qui regarde les choses de Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በሌላው ሰው መሠረት ላይ እንዳልሠራ የክርስቶስ ስም በተጠራበት ስፍራ ሳይሆን ወንጌልን ለመስበክ ተጣጣርሁ፤

verses.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
verses.fr: Car je n''oserais mentionner aucune chose que Christ n''ait pas faite par moi pour amener les païens à l''obéissance, par la parole et par les actes,
verses.am: እንዲሁም በሌላው ሰው መሠረት ላይ እንዳልሠራ የክርስቶስ ስም በተጠራበት ስፍራ ሳይሆን ወንጌልን ለመስበክ ተጣጣርሁ፤

verses.en: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
verses.fr: par la puissance des miracles et des prodiges, par la puissance de l''Esprit de Dieu, en sorte que, depuis Jérusalem et les pays voisins jusqu''en Illyrie, j''ai abondamment répandu l''Evangile de Christ.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ስለ እርሱ ያልተወራላቸው ያያሉ፥ ያልሰሙም ያስተውላሉ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ነው።

verses.en: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
verses.fr: Et je me suis fait honneur d''annoncer l''Evangile là où Christ n''avait point été nommé, afin de ne pas bâtir sur le fondement d''autrui,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ወደ እናንተ እንዳልመጣ ብዙ ጊዜ ተከለከልሁ።

verses.en: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: Ceux à qui il n''avait point été annoncé verront, Et ceux qui n''en avaient point entendu parler comprendront.
verses.am: አሁን ግን በዚህ አገር ስፍራ ወደ ፊት ስለሌለኝ፥ ከብዙ ዓመትም ጀምሬ ወደ እናንተ ልመጣ ናፍቆት ስላለኝ፥

verses.en: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
verses.fr: C''est ce qui m''a souvent empêché d''aller vers vous.
verses.am: ወደ እስጳንያ በሄድሁ ጊዜ ሳልፍ እናንተን እንዳይ፥ አስቀድሜም ጥቂት ብጠግባችሁ ወደዚያ በጉዞዬ እንድትረዱኝ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
verses.fr: Mais maintenant, n''ayant plus rien qui me retienne dans ces contrées, et ayant depuis plusieurs années le désir d''aller vers vous,
verses.am: አሁን ግን ቅዱሳንን ለማገልገል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
verses.fr: j''espère vous voir en passant, quand je me rendrai en Espagne, et y être accompagné par vous, après que j''aurai satisfait en partie mon désir de me trouver chez vous.
verses.am: መቄዶንያና አካይያ በኢየሩሳሌም ቅዱሳን መካከል ያሉትን ድሆች ይረዱ ዘንድ ወደዋልና።

verses.en: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
verses.fr: Présentement je vais à Jérusalem, pour le service des saints.
verses.am: ወደዋልና፥ የእነርሱም ባለ ዕዳዎች ናቸው፤ አሕዛብ በእነርሱ መንፈሳዊ ነገርን ተካፋዮች ከሆኑ በሥጋዊ ነገር ደግሞ ያገለግሉአቸው ዘንድ ይገባቸዋልና።

verses.en: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Car la Macédoine et l''Achaïe ont bien voulu s''imposer une contribution en faveur des pauvres parmi les saints de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ይህን ፈጽሜ ይህን ፍሬ ካተምሁላቸው በኋላ በእናንተ በኩል አልፌ ወደ እስጳንያ እሄዳለሁ፤

verses.en: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
verses.fr: Elles l''ont bien voulu, et elles le leur devaient; car si les païens ont eu part à leurs avantages spirituels, ils doivent aussi les assister dans les choses temporelles.
verses.am: ወደ እናንተም ስመጣ በክርስቶስ በረከት ሙላት እንድመጣ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
verses.fr: Dès que j''aurai terminé cette affaire et que je leur aurai remis ces dons, je partirai pour l''Espagne et passerai chez vous.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ስለ እኔ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እየጸለያችሁ ከእኔ ጋር ትጋደሉ ዘንድ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስና በመንፈስ ፍቅር እለምናችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
verses.fr: Je sais qu''en allant vers vous, c''est avec une pleine bénédiction de Christ que j''irai.
verses.am: የሰላምም አምላክ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
verses.fr: Je vous exhorte, frères, par notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ et par l''amour de l''Esprit, à combattre avec moi, en adressant à Dieu des prières en ma faveur,
verses.am: የሰላምም አምላክ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
verses.fr: afin que je sois délivré des incrédules de la Judée, et que les dons que je porte à Jérusalem soient agréés des saints,

verses.en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
verses.fr: en sorte que j''arrive chez vous avec joie, si c''est la volonté de Dieu, et que je jouisse au milieu de vous de quelque repos.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ በደስታ ወደ እናንተ መጥቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እንዳርፍ፥ በይሁዳ ካሉት ከማይታዘዙ እድን ዘንድ፥ ለኢየሩሳሌምም ያለኝ አገልግሎቴ ቅዱሳንን ደስ የሚያሰኝ ይሆን ዘንድ ጸልዩ።

verses.en: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.fr: Que le Dieu de paix soit avec vous tous! Amen!
verses.am: የሰላምም አምላክ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
verses.fr: Je vous recommande Phoebé, notre soeur, qui est diaconesse de l''Eglise de Cenchrées,
verses.am: በክንክራኦስ ባለች ቤተ ክርስቲያን አገልጋይ የምትሆን እኅታችንን ፌቤንን አደራ ብያችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
verses.fr: afin que vous la receviez en notre Seigneur d''une manière digne des saints, et que vous l''assistiez dans les choses où elle aurait besoin de vous, car elle a donné aide à plusieurs et à moi-même.
verses.am: ለቅዱሳን እንደሚገባ በጌታ ተቀበሉአት፥ እርስዋ ለብዙዎች ለእኔም ለራሴ ደጋፊ ነበረችና፥ ከእናንተም በምትፈልገው በማናቸውም ነገር እርዱአት።

verses.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
verses.fr: Saluez Prisca et Aquilas, mes compagnons d''oeuvre en Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ አብረውኝ ለሚሠሩ ለጵርስቅላና ለአቂላ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ፤

verses.en: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
verses.fr: qui ont exposé leur tête pour sauver ma vie; ce n''est pas moi seul qui leur rends grâces, ce sont encore toutes les Eglises des païens.
verses.am: እነርሱም ስለ ነፍሴ ነፍሳቸውን ለሞት አቀረቡ፥ የአሕዛብም አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ የሚያመሰግኑአቸው ናቸው እንጂ እኔ ብቻ አይደለሁም፤

verses.en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
verses.fr: Saluez aussi l''Eglise qui est dans leur maison. Saluez Epaïnète, mon bien-aimé, qui a été pour Christ les prémices de l''Asie.
verses.am: በቤታቸውም ላለች ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። ከእስያ ለክርስቶስ በኵራት ለሆነው ለምወደው ለአጤኔጦን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
verses.fr: Saluez Marie, qui a pris beaucoup de peine pour vous.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ ብዙ ለደከመች ለማርያ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.fr: Saluez Andronicus et Junias, mes parents et mes compagnons de captivité, qui jouissent d''une grande considération parmi les apôtres, et qui même ont été en Christ avant moi.
verses.am: በሐዋርያት መካከል ስመ ጥሩዎች ለሆኑ፥ ደግሞም ክርስቶስን በማመን ለቀደሙኝ፥ አብረውኝም ለታሰሩ ለዘመዶቼ ለአንዲራኒቆንና ለዩልያን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
verses.fr: Saluez Amplias, mon bien-aimé dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: በጌታ ለምወደው ለጵልያጦን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.fr: Saluez Urbain, notre compagnon d''oeuvre en Christ, et Stachys, mon bien-aimé.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ አብሮን ለሚሠራ ለኢሩባኖን ለምወደውም ለስንጣክን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
verses.fr: Saluez Apellès, qui est éprouvé en Christ. Saluez ceux de la maison d''Aristobule.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ መሆኑ ተፈትኖ ለተመሰገነው ለኤጤሌን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። ከአርስጣባሉ ቤተ ሰዎች ላሉት ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
verses.fr: Saluez Hérodion, mon parent. Saluez ceux de la maison de Narcisse qui sont dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: ለዘመዴ ለሄሮድዮና ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። ከንርቀሱ ቤተ ሰዎች በጌታ ላሉት ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
verses.fr: Saluez Tryphène et Tryphose, qui travaillent pour le Seigneur. Saluez Perside, la bien-aimée, qui a beaucoup travaillé pour le Seigneur.
verses.am: በጌታ ሆነው ለሚደክሙ ለፕሮፊሞናና ለጢሮፊሞሳ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። በጌታ እጅግ ለደከመች ለተወደደች ለጠርሲዳ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.fr: Saluez Rufus, l''élu du Seigneur, et sa mère, qui est aussi la mienne.
verses.am: በጌታ ሆኖ ለታወቀ ለሩፎን ለእኔና ለእርሱም እናት ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
verses.fr: Saluez Asyncrite, Phlégon, Hermès, Patrobas, Hermas, et les frères qui sont avec eux.
verses.am: ለአስቀሪጦንና ለአፍለሶንጳ ለሄሮሜንም ለጳጥሮባም ለሄርማንም ከእነርሱም ጋር ላሉ ወንድሞች ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
verses.fr: Saluez Philologue et Julie, Nérée et sa soeur, et Olympe, et tous les saints qui sont avec eux.
verses.am: ለፍሌጎንና ለዩልያ ለኔርያና ለእኅቱም ለአልንጦንም ከእነርሱ ጋር ላሉ ቅዱሳን ሁሉ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

verses.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
verses.fr: Saluez-vous les uns les autres par un saint baiser. Toutes les Eglises de Christ vous saluent.
verses.am: በተቀደሰ አሳሳም እርስ በርሳችሁ ሰላምታ ተሰጣጡ። የክርስቶስ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
verses.fr: Je vous exhorte, frères, à prendre garde à ceux qui causent des divisions et des scandales, au préjudice de l''enseignement que vous avez reçu. Eloignez-vous d''eux.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እናንተ የተማራችሁትን ትምህርት የሚቃወሙትን መለያየትንና ማሰናከያን የሚያደርጉትን ሰዎች እንድትመለከቱ እለምናችኋለሁ፥ ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ፈቀቅ በሉ፤

verses.en: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
verses.fr: Car de tels hommes ne servent point Christ notre Seigneur, mais leur propre ventre; et, par des paroles douces et flatteuses, ils séduisent les coeurs des simples.
verses.am: እንዲህ ያሉት ለገዛ ሆዳቸው እንጂ ለጌታችን ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አይገዙምና፥ በመልካምና በሚያቆላምጥ ንግግርም ተንኮል የሌለባቸውን ሰዎች ልብ ያታልላሉ።

verses.en: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
verses.fr: Pour vous, votre obéissance est connue de tous; je me réjouis donc à votre sujet, et je désire que vous soyez sages en ce qui concerne le bien et purs en ce qui concerne le mal.
verses.am: መታዘዛችሁ ለሁሉ ተወርቶአልና፤ እንግዲህ በእናንተ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ነገር ግን ለበጎ ነገር ጥበበኞች ለክፉም የዋሆች እንድትሆኑ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.fr: Le Dieu de paix écrasera bientôt Satan sous vos pieds. Que la grâce de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ soit avec vous!
verses.am: የሰላምም አምላክ ሰይጣንን ከእግራችሁ በታች ፈጥኖ ይቀጠቅጠዋል። የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
verses.fr: Timothée, mon compagnon d''oeuvre, vous salue, ainsi que Lucius, Jason et Sosipater, mes parents.
verses.am: አብሮኝ የሚሠራ ጢሞቴዎስ ዘመዶቼም ሉቂዮስና ኢያሶን ሱሲጴጥሮስም ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.fr: Je vous salue dans le Seigneur, moi Tertius, qui ai écrit cette lettre.
verses.am: ይህን መልእክት የጻፍሁ እኔ ጤርጥዮስ በጌታ ሰላምታ አቀርብላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
verses.fr: Gaïus, mon hôte et celui de toute l''Eglise, vous salue. Eraste, le trésorier de la ville, vous salue, ainsi que le frère Quartus.
verses.am: የእኔና የቤተ ክርስቲያን ሁሉ አስተናጋጅ ጋይዮስ ሰላምታ ያቀርብላችኋል። የከተማው መጋቢ ኤርስጦስ ወንድማችንም ቁአስጥሮስ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.fr: Que la grâce de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ soit avec vous tous! Amen!
verses.am: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
verses.fr: A celui qui peut vous affermir selon mon Evangile et la prédication de Jésus-Christ, conformément à la révélation du mystère caché pendant des siècles,
verses.am: ብቻውን ጥበብ ላለው ለእግዚአብሔር በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
verses.fr: mais manifesté maintenant par les écrits des prophètes, d''après l''ordre du Dieu éternel, et porté à la connaissance de toutes les nations, afin qu''elles obéissent à la foi,
verses.am: ብቻውን ጥበብ ላለው ለእግዚአብሔር በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
verses.fr: Dieu, seul sage, soit la gloire aux siècles des siècles, par Jésus-Christ! Amen!
